    "text.color":         "black",
    "axes.labelcolor":    "black",
    "xtick.color":        "black",
    "ytick.color":        "black",
})

# Paleta accesible para daltónicos (Wong 2011, 8 colores)
WONG_PALETTE = [
    "#000000",  # black
    "#E69F00",  # orange
    "#56B4E9",  # sky blue
    "#009E73",  # bluish green
    "#F0E442",  # yellow
    "#0072B2",  # blue
    "#D55E00",  # vermillion
    "#CC79A7",  # reddish purple
]

# ─── Configuración ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

DATA_DIR   = Path("data")
INPUT_FILE = DATA_DIR / "diabetes-retin.csv"
SYNTH_BASE = Path("synth_samples")
EVAL_DIR   = Path("evaluation_results")
OUTPUT_DIR = EVAL_DIR / "plots"
TARGET_COL = "Outcome"

RIDGE_VARS   = ["Glucose", "BMI"]
TOP_N_MODELS = 3
SAVE_FORMATS = ["png", "pdf"]
DPI          = 300

# Marcadores distintos por modelo para gráficos b/w imprimibles
MODEL_MARKERS = {
    "great":           "o",
    "tabula":          "s",
    "realtabformer":   "^",
    "ctgan":           "D",
    "tvae":            "v",
    "gaussian_copula": "P",
    "copulagan":       "X",
    "tabpfgen":        "h",
    "forestdiffusion": "*",
    "mostlyai":        "p",
}
DEFAULT_MARKER = "o"


# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_data():
    real      = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
    per_class = pd.read_csv(EVAL_DIR / "evaluation_per_class.csv")
    tstr      = pd.read_csv(EVAL_DIR / "evaluation_tstr.csv")
    return real, per_class, tstr


def load_synth(model: str, label: int) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
    p = SYNTH_BASE / model / f"class_{label}" / f"synthetic_class_{label}.csv"
    return pd.read_csv(p) if p.exists() else None


def feature_cols(df: pd.DataFrame) -> list[str]:
    return [c for c in df.columns if c != TARGET_COL]


def save_fig(fig, name: str):
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for fmt in SAVE_FORMATS:
        path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{name}.{fmt}"
        fig.savefig(path, dpi=DPI, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
        print(f"  Saved: {path}")


def assign_colors_markers(models: list[str]):
    """Asigna colores de la paleta Wong y marcadores a cada modelo."""
    colors  = {}
    markers = {}
    for i, m in enumerate(models):
        colors[m]  = WONG_PALETTE[i % len(WONG_PALETTE)]
        markers[m] = MODEL_MARKERS.get(m, DEFAULT_MARKER)
    return colors, markers


# ─── A. Scatter: Privacidad vs Utilidad ───────────────────────────────────────

def plot_scatter_privacy_utility(per_class: pd.DataFrame, tstr: pd.DataFrame):
    print("A. Scatter: Privacidad vs Utilidad")

    models = sorted(per_class["model"].unique().tolist())
    colors, markers = assign_colors_markers(models)

    for label in [0, 1]:
        subset = per_class[per_class["class"] == label][["model", "dcr_mean"]].copy()
        merged = subset.merge(tstr[["model", "tstr_auc_ratio"]], on="model", how="inner")
        if merged.empty:
            print(f"  No data for class {label}")
            continue

        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 4.5))

        for _, row in merged.iterrows():
            m = row["model"]
            ax.scatter(
                row["dcr_mean"], row["tstr_auc_ratio"],
                color=colors.get(m, WONG_PALETTE[0]),
                marker=markers.get(m, DEFAULT_MARKER),
                s=60, zorder=5, linewidths=0.5, edgecolors="black",
                label=m,
            )

        # Línea de referencia TRTR (utilidad = 1.0)
        ax.axhline(1.0, color="black", linestyle=":", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5,
                   label="TRTR baseline")

        # Mediana de DCR como referencia vertical
        xmed = merged["dcr_mean"].median()
        ax.axvline(xmed, color="black", linestyle=":", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5)

        ax.set_xlabel(r"$\overline{DCR}$ (Privacy — higher is better)")
        ax.set_ylabel(r"$TSTR_{AUC}$ ratio (Utility — higher is better)")
        ax.set_title(f"Privacy–Utility Trade-off (Class {label})")

        # Leyenda fuera del área del gráfico
        ax.legend(
            loc="upper left",
            bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1.0),
            borderaxespad=0,
            frameon=True,
            framealpha=0.9,
            edgecolor="#CCCCCC",
            fontsize=7.5,
        )

        ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(ticker.AutoMinorLocator())
        ax.yaxis.set_minor_locator(ticker.AutoMinorLocator())

        fig.tight_layout()
        save_fig(fig, f"A_scatter_privacy_utility_class{label}")
        plt.close(fig)


# ─── B. Heatmaps de correlación ───────────────────────────────────────────────

def plot_heatmaps(real: pd.DataFrame, per_class: pd.DataFrame):
    print("B. Heatmaps de correlación")
    feat = feature_cols(real)

    cmap = sns.diverging_palette(220, 20, as_cmap=True)

    for label in [0, 1]:
        real_class = real[real[TARGET_COL] == label][feat]
        corr_real  = real_class.corr()

        models  = sorted([p.name for p in SYNTH_BASE.iterdir() if p.is_dir()])
        n_total = len(models) + 1   # +1 para real
        ncols   = 3
        nrows   = (n_total + ncols - 1) // ncols

        fig, axes = plt.subplots(
            nrows, ncols,
            figsize=(ncols * 3.8, nrows * 3.5),
        )
        axes = axes.flatten()

        fig.suptitle(
            f"Pearson Correlation Matrices — Class {label}",
            fontsize=12, y=1.01,
        )

        def draw_hm(ax, corr, title, is_real=False):
            sns.heatmap(
                corr, ax=ax,
                cmap=cmap, vmin=-1, vmax=1,
                annot=True, fmt=".2f",
                annot_kws={"size": 5.5},
                linewidths=0.3, linecolor="#E0E0E0",
                cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.75, "aspect": 15},
                square=True,
            )
            weight = "bold" if is_real else "normal"
            prefix = "★ " if is_real else ""
            ax.set_title(f"{prefix}{title}", fontsize=8.5, fontweight=weight, pad=4)
            ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=6)
            ax.set_xlabel("")
            ax.set_ylabel("")

        draw_hm(axes[0], corr_real, "Real data", is_real=True)

        for idx, model in enumerate(models):
            synth = load_synth(model, label)
            if synth is None:
                axes[idx + 1].axis("off")
                continue
            synth_feat = [c for c in feat if c in synth.columns]
            corr_s = synth[synth_feat].corr().reindex(index=feat, columns=feat).fillna(0)

            row_eval = per_class[
                (per_class["model"] == model) & (per_class["class"] == label)
            ]
            dist = row_eval["corr_distance"].values[0] if not row_eval.empty else float("nan")
            draw_hm(axes[idx + 1], corr_s, f"{model}\n(d={dist:.3f})")

        for i in range(len(models) + 1, len(axes)):
            axes[i].axis("off")

        fig.tight_layout()
        save_fig(fig, f"B_heatmaps_correlation_class{label}")
        plt.close(fig)


# ─── C. Ridge plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def plot_ridge(real: pd.DataFrame, per_class: pd.DataFrame):
    print("C. Ridge plots de densidad")

    for label in [0, 1]:
        subset = per_class[per_class["class"] == label].copy()
        if subset.empty:
            continue

        top_models = subset.nsmallest(TOP_N_MODELS, "ks_stat_mean")["model"].tolist()
        real_class = real[real[TARGET_COL] == label]

        all_models_here = ["Real"] + top_models
        colors, _ = assign_colors_markers(top_models)
        colors["Real"] = "#000000"

        for var in RIDGE_VARS:
            if var not in real.columns:
                print(f"  Variable {var} not found, skipping")
                continue

            entries = [("Real", real_class[var].dropna().values)]
            for model in top_models:
                synth = load_synth(model, label)
                if synth is not None and var in synth.columns:
                    entries.append((model, synth[var].dropna().values))

            n = len(entries)
            # Altura proporcional al número de distribuciones
            fig, axes = plt.subplots(
                n, 1, figsize=(5.5, 1.4 * n + 0.8),
                sharex=True,
            )
            if n == 1:
                axes = [axes]

            fig.suptitle(
                f"Density Distribution: {var} (Class {label})",
                fontsize=11,
            )

            all_vals = np.concatenate([e[1] for e in entries])
            x_min = np.percentile(all_vals, 0.5)
            x_max = np.percentile(all_vals, 99.5)
            x_range = np.linspace(x_min, x_max, 500)

            for ax, (name, vals) in zip(axes, entries):
                color = colors.get(name, WONG_PALETTE[0])
                try:
                    kde     = gaussian_kde(vals, bw_method="scott")
                    density = kde(x_range)
                    ax.fill_between(x_range, density, alpha=0.25, color=color)
                    ax.plot(x_range, density, color=color, linewidth=1.2)
                except Exception:
                    ax.hist(vals, bins=20, density=True, color=color,
                            alpha=0.4, linewidth=0.6, edgecolor="black")

                # Mediana
                med = np.median(vals)
                ax.axvline(med, color=color, linestyle="--",
                           linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.7)

                # Etiqueta del modelo a la izquierda
                ax.set_ylabel(name, fontsize=8, rotation=0,
                              labelpad=70, va="center")
                ax.set_yticks([])
                ax.spines["left"].set_visible(False)
                ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
                ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
                ax.set_xlim(x_min, x_max)

            axes[-1].set_xlabel(var)
            fig.tight_layout()
            fig.subplots_adjust(hspace=0.05)

            var_safe = var.lower().replace(" ", "_")
            save_fig(fig, f"C_ridge_{var_safe}_class{label}")
            plt.close(fig)


# ─── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print("Loading evaluation data...")
    real, per_class, tstr = load_data()

    plot_scatter_privacy_utility(per_class, tstr)
    plot_heatmaps(real, per_class)
    plot_ridge(real, per_class)

    print(f"\nAll plots saved to: {OUTPUT_DIR}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import logging
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.figure import Figure

from src.plots.styles import MODEL_COLORS, MODEL_FAMILIES


def draw_family_bands(ax, model_order: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
    for family in MODEL_FAMILIES:
        indices = [
            model_order.index(model)
            for model in family["models"]
            if model in model_order
        ]

        if not indices:
            continue

        start = min(indices) - 0.5
        end = max(indices) + 0.5

        ax.axvspan(
            start,
            end,
            facecolor=family["color"],
            alpha=0.55,
            zorder=0,
        )
        ax.axvline(
            end,
            color="white",
            linewidth=2.0,
            zorder=1,
        )


def style_boxplot(boxplot, model_order: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
    for box, model in zip(boxplot["boxes"], model_order):
        box.set(
            facecolor=MODEL_COLORS[model],
            edgecolor="black",
            alpha=0.90,
            linewidth=0.85,
            zorder=3,
        )

    for key in ("whiskers", "caps"):
        for item in boxplot[key]:
            item.set(
                color="black",
                linewidth=0.8,
                zorder=3,
            )

    for median in boxplot["medians"]:
        median.set(
            color="black",
            linewidth=1.15,
            zorder=4,
        )


def finite_values(values) -> np.ndarray:
    array = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    return array[np.isfinite(array)]


def save_figure(
    figure: Figure,
    output_dir: Path,
    basename: str,
    png_dpi: int,
    logger: logging.Logger,
) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    png_path = output_dir.joinpath(f"{basename}.png")
    pdf_path = output_dir.joinpath(f"{basename}.pdf")

    try:
        figure.savefig(
            png_path,
            dpi=png_dpi,
            bbox_inches="tight",
        )
        logger.info("Saved PNG: %s", png_path)

        figure.savefig(
            pdf_path,
            bbox_inches="tight",
        )
        logger.info("Saved PDF: %s", pdf_path)
    finally:
        plt.close(figure)

    return png_path, pdf_path

import logging
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd


def load_aggregated_metrics(
    datasets: tuple[str, ...],
    data_dir: Path,
    logger: logging.Logger,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    frames = []
    missing_files = []

    logger.info("Loading aggregated metrics")

    for dataset in datasets:
        path = data_dir.joinpath(f"{dataset}_aggregated.csv")

        if not path.exists():
            missing_files.append(path)
            continue

        frame = pd.read_csv(path)
        frames.append(frame)
        logger.debug("Loaded %s rows from %s", len(frame), path)

    for path in missing_files:
        logger.warning("Missing metrics file: %s", path)

    if not frames:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"No aggregated metric files were found in: {data_dir}"
        )

    data = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    logger.info("Loaded %s aggregated metric rows", len(data))
    return data


def require_columns(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
    context: str,
) -> None:
    missing = [column for column in columns if column not in data.columns]

    if missing:
        names = ", ".join(missing)
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns for {context}: {names}.")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.figure import Figure
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
from typing import Optional

from src.plots.common import draw_family_bands, finite_values, style_boxplot
from src.plots.data import require_columns
from src.plots.styles import (
    MODEL_COLORS,
    MODEL_FAMILIES,
    MODEL_LABELS,
    dataset_label,
)

PANEL_SPECS = (
    {
        "title": "DCR mean / holdout\nmean (→ 1)",
        "metric": "ratio_dcr_mean",
        "reference": 1.0,
        "yscale": "log",
    },
    {
        "title": "MIA AUC (→ 0.5)",
        "metric": "mia_auc",
        "reference": 0.5,
        "yscale": "linear",
    },
    {
        "title": "MIA advantage (↓)",
        "metric": "mia_advantage",
        "reference": 0.0,
        "yscale": "linear",
    },
    {
        "title": "NNAA (→ 0.5)",
        "metric": "nnaa",
        "reference": 0.5,
        "yscale": "linear",
    },
    {
        "title": "k-anonymity k=3 ratio (↑)",
        "metric": "kanon_k3_ratio",
        "reference": None,
        "yscale": "linear",
    },
    {
        "title": "k-anonymity k=5 ratio (↑)",
        "metric": "kanon_k5_ratio",
        "reference": None,
        "yscale": "linear",
    },
)

FONT_SIZES = {
    "default": 14,
    "suptitle": 19,
    "panel_title": 17,
    "dataset_label": 11,
    "x_tick": 14,
    "y_tick": 14,
    "model_legend": 15,
    "model_legend_title": 16,
    "family_legend": 14,
    "family_legend_title": 15,
    "reference_legend": 14,
}


def build_privacy_table(
    raw_data: pd.DataFrame,
    datasets: tuple[str, ...],
    model_order: tuple[str, ...],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    require_columns(
        raw_data,
        ("dataset", "model", "output_ir", "block", "metric", "mean"),
        "privacy plot",
    )

    data = raw_data[
        raw_data["dataset"].isin(datasets)
        & raw_data["model"].isin(model_order)
    ].copy()
    index_columns = ("dataset", "model", "output_ir")

    dcr = _pivot_metrics(
        data,
        "privacy_dcr",
        ("dcr_mean", "dcr_holdout_mean"),
        index_columns,
    )
    dcr["ratio_dcr_mean"] = (
        dcr["dcr_mean"] / dcr["dcr_holdout_mean"]
    ).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    mia = _pivot_metrics(
        data,
        "privacy_mia",
        ("mia_auc", "mia_advantage"),
        index_columns,
    )
    nnaa = _pivot_metrics(
        data,
        "privacy_nnaa",
        ("nnaa",),
        index_columns,
    )
    kanon = _pivot_metrics(
        data,
        "privacy_kanonymity",
        ("kanon_k3_ratio", "kanon_k5_ratio"),
        index_columns,
    )

    privacy = dcr[list(index_columns) + ["ratio_dcr_mean"]]
    privacy = privacy.merge(
        mia[list(index_columns) + ["mia_auc", "mia_advantage"]],
        on=list(index_columns),
        how="outer",
    )
    privacy = privacy.merge(
        nnaa[list(index_columns) + ["nnaa"]],
        on=list(index_columns),
        how="outer",
    )
    privacy = privacy.merge(
        kanon[
            list(index_columns)
            + ["kanon_k3_ratio", "kanon_k5_ratio"]
        ],
        on=list(index_columns),
        how="outer",
    )

    if privacy.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            "No privacy metrics were found for the selected datasets."
        )

    privacy["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(
        privacy["dataset"],
        categories=datasets,
        ordered=True,
    )
    privacy["model"] = pd.Categorical(
        privacy["model"],
        categories=model_order,
        ordered=True,
    )

    return privacy.sort_values(["dataset", "model", "output_ir"])


def privacy_output_basename() -> str:
    return "figure_privacy_profiles_taxonomy"


def create_privacy_figure(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    datasets: tuple[str, ...],
    model_order: tuple[str, ...],
    include_title: bool,
) -> Figure:
    datasets_to_plot = tuple(
        dataset
        for dataset in datasets
        if dataset in data["dataset"].dropna().astype(str).unique()
    )

    if not datasets_to_plot:
        raise ValueError("No valid datasets were found after filtering.")

    plt.rcParams.update(
        {
            "font.size": FONT_SIZES["default"],
            "font.family": "sans-serif",
            "axes.titlesize": FONT_SIZES["panel_title"],
            "axes.labelsize": FONT_SIZES["dataset_label"],
            "xtick.labelsize": FONT_SIZES["x_tick"],
            "ytick.labelsize": FONT_SIZES["y_tick"],
            "legend.fontsize": FONT_SIZES["model_legend"],
            "legend.title_fontsize": FONT_SIZES["model_legend_title"],
        }
    )

    figure, axes = plt.subplots(
        len(datasets_to_plot),
        len(PANEL_SPECS),
        figsize=(22, max(9, 2.85 * len(datasets_to_plot))),
        sharex=True,
        sharey=False,
        squeeze=False,
    )
    positions = np.arange(len(model_order))

    for row_index, dataset in enumerate(datasets_to_plot):
        for column_index, panel in enumerate(PANEL_SPECS):
            ax = axes[row_index, column_index]
            subset = data[data["dataset"] == dataset]
            _plot_panel(ax, subset, panel, positions, model_order)
            ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=FONT_SIZES["y_tick"])

            if row_index == 0:
                ax.set_title(
                    panel["title"],
                    fontsize=FONT_SIZES["panel_title"],
                    loc="left",
                )

            if column_index == 0:
                ax.set_ylabel(
                    dataset_label(dataset),
                    fontsize=FONT_SIZES["dataset_label"],
                )

            if row_index == len(datasets_to_plot) - 1:
                ax.set_xticks(positions)
                ax.set_xticklabels(
                    [MODEL_LABELS[model] for model in model_order],
                    rotation=60,
                    ha="right",
                    fontsize=FONT_SIZES["x_tick"],
                )
            else:
                ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelbottom=False)

    model_handles = [
        Patch(
            facecolor=MODEL_COLORS[model],
            edgecolor="black",
            label=MODEL_LABELS[model],
            alpha=0.90,
        )
        for model in model_order
    ]
    family_handles = [
        Patch(
            facecolor=family["color"],
            edgecolor="none",
            label=family["label"],
            alpha=0.75,
        )
        for family in MODEL_FAMILIES
    ]
    reference_handle = [
        Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            color="#4A4A4A",
            linestyle="--",
            linewidth=0.9,
            label="Reference value",
        )
    ]
    model_legend = figure.legend(
        handles=model_handles,
        loc="lower center",
        ncol=5,
        frameon=True,
        fancybox=True,
        fontsize=FONT_SIZES["model_legend"],
        title="Generative model color code",
        title_fontsize=FONT_SIZES["model_legend_title"],
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.07),
        borderpad=0.8,
        columnspacing=1.4,
        handlelength=1.6,
    )
    family_legend = figure.legend(
        handles=family_handles,
        loc="lower center",
        ncol=3,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=FONT_SIZES["family_legend"],
        title="Taxonomic family bands",
        title_fontsize=FONT_SIZES["family_legend_title"],
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.025),
        columnspacing=1.6,
        handlelength=1.8,
    )
    figure.legend(
        handles=reference_handle,
        loc="lower center",
        ncol=1,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=FONT_SIZES["reference_legend"],
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.005),
        handlelength=1.8,
    )
    figure.add_artist(model_legend)
    figure.add_artist(family_legend)

    if include_title:
        figure.suptitle(
            "Privacy evaluation profiles by dataset",
            fontsize=FONT_SIZES["suptitle"],
            y=0.995,
        )

    figure.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.15, 1, 0.975])
    return figure


def _pivot_metrics(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    block: str,
    metrics: tuple[str, ...],
    index_columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    subset = data[
        (data["block"] == block)
        & data["metric"].isin(metrics)
    ]

    if subset.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=list(index_columns) + list(metrics))

    pivoted = (
        subset.pivot_table(
            index=list(index_columns),
            columns="metric",
            values="mean",
            aggfunc="mean",
            observed=False,
        )
        .reset_index()
        .rename_axis(None, axis=1)
    )

    for metric in metrics:
        if metric not in pivoted.columns:
            pivoted[metric] = np.nan

    return pivoted


def _plot_panel(
    ax,
    subset: pd.DataFrame,
    panel: dict,
    positions: np.ndarray,
    model_order: tuple[str, ...],
) -> None:
    draw_family_bands(ax, model_order)
    values = [
        _boxplot_values(subset, model, panel["metric"])
        for model in model_order
    ]
    boxplot = ax.boxplot(
        values,
        positions=positions,
        widths=0.45,
        patch_artist=True,
        showfliers=False,
        manage_ticks=False,
    )
    style_boxplot(boxplot, model_order)

    if panel["reference"] is not None:
        ax.axhline(
            panel["reference"],
            color="#4A4A4A",
            linestyle="--",
            linewidth=0.9,
            zorder=2,
        )

    y_min, y_max = _subplot_limits(
        subset,
        panel["metric"],
        panel["reference"],
        panel["yscale"],
    )
    ax.set_yscale(panel["yscale"])
    ax.set_ylim(y_min, y_max)
    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(model_order) - 0.5)
    ax.grid(
        axis="y",
        linestyle=":",
        linewidth=0.5,
        alpha=0.65,
        zorder=2,
    )


def _boxplot_values(
    subset: pd.DataFrame,
    model: str,
    metric: str,
) -> np.ndarray:
    values = finite_values(subset[subset["model"] == model][metric])
    return values if len(values) else np.array([np.nan])


def _subplot_limits(
    subset: pd.DataFrame,
    metric: str,
    reference: Optional[float],
    yscale: str,
) -> tuple[float, float]:
    values = finite_values(subset[metric])

    if reference is not None:
        values = np.concatenate([values, np.array([reference])])

    if yscale == "log":
        values = values[values > 0]

    if not len(values):
        return (1e-3, 1.0) if yscale == "log" else (0.0, 1.0)

    y_min = float(np.min(values))
    y_max = float(np.max(values))

    if np.isclose(y_min, y_max):
        margin = 0.01 if y_max == 0 else abs(y_max) * 0.01
        y_min -= margin
        y_max += margin

    if yscale == "log":
        y_min *= 0.95
        y_max *= 1.05
    else:
        y_min = max(0.0, y_min) if y_min >= 0 else y_min
        y_max = min(1.0, y_max) if y_max <= 1.0 else y_max

    return y_min, y_max

import logging

from config.const import (
    METRICS_AGGREGATED_DIR,
    PRIVACY_FIGURES_DIR,
    TRADEOFF_FIGURES_DIR,
    UTILITY_FIGURES_DIR,
)
from src.plots.common import save_figure

    privacy_output_basename,

    build_tradeoff_table,
    create_tradeoff_figure,
    tradeoff_output_basename,
)
from src.plots.utility import (
    build_utility_table,
    create_utility_figure,
    utility_output_basename,

def run_plot_command(
    command: str,
    settings: PlotSettings,
    datasets: tuple[str, ...],
    classifier: str,
    output_ir: float,
    include_title: bool,
    logger: logging.Logger,
) -> None:
    validate_model_styles(settings.model_order)
    raw_data = load_aggregated_metrics(
        datasets,
        METRICS_AGGREGATED_DIR,
        logger,
    )

    if command in ("utility", "all"):

from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
from pathlib import Path

from config.const import PARAMS_FILE


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlotSettings:
    available_datasets: tuple[str, ...]
    default_datasets: tuple[str, ...]
    available_models: tuple[str, ...]
    model_order: tuple[str, ...]
    supported_classifiers: tuple[str, ...]
    default_classifier: str
    default_output_ir: float
    default_title: bool
    png_dpi: int


def load_plot_settings(params_file: Path = PARAMS_FILE) -> PlotSettings:
    with params_file.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
        params = json.load(file)

    experiment = params.get("experiment")
    plots = params.get("plots")

    if not isinstance(experiment, dict):
        raise ValueError("Missing 'experiment' section in params.json.")

    if not isinstance(plots, dict):
        raise ValueError("Missing 'plots' section in params.json.")

    settings = PlotSettings(
        available_datasets=tuple(experiment.get("datasets", [])),
        default_datasets=tuple(plots.get("datasets", [])),
        available_models=tuple(experiment.get("models", [])),
        model_order=tuple(plots.get("model_order", [])),
        supported_classifiers=tuple(plots.get("supported_classifiers", [])),
        default_classifier=str(plots.get("default_classifier", "xgboost")),
        default_output_ir=float(plots.get("default_output_ir", 1.0)),
        default_title=bool(plots.get("default_title", False)),
        png_dpi=int(plots.get("png_dpi", 300)),
    )

    validate_plot_settings(settings)
    return settings


def validate_plot_settings(settings: PlotSettings) -> None:
    if not settings.available_datasets:
        raise ValueError("No datasets are configured in experiment.datasets.")

    if not settings.default_datasets:
        raise ValueError("No default datasets are configured in plots.datasets.")

    unsupported_datasets = [
        dataset
        for dataset in settings.default_datasets
        if dataset not in settings.available_datasets
    ]

    if unsupported_datasets:
        names = ", ".join(unsupported_datasets)
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported default datasets: {names}.")

    if not settings.model_order:
        raise ValueError("No models are configured in plots.model_order.")

    unsupported_models = [
        model
        for model in settings.model_order
        if model not in settings.available_models
    ]

    if unsupported_models:
        names = ", ".join(unsupported_models)
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported plot models: {names}.")

    if settings.default_classifier not in settings.supported_classifiers:
        raise ValueError(
            "plots.default_classifier must be included in "
            "plots.supported_classifiers."
        )

    if settings.default_output_ir <= 0:
        raise ValueError("plots.default_output_ir must be greater than zero.")

    if settings.png_dpi <= 0:
        raise ValueError("plots.png_dpi must be greater than zero.")

import numpy as np

REFERENCE_LEGEND_Y = -0.010

DYNAMIC_Y_AXIS_SETTINGS = {

    },

    },

PANEL_SPECS = (
    {
        "title": "MIA AUC (→ 0.5)\nvs. TSTR AUC-ROC (↑)",
        "xmetric": "tstr_aucroc",

def build_tradeoff_table(
    raw_data: pd.DataFrame,
    datasets: tuple[str, ...],
    model_order: tuple[str, ...],
    classifier: str,
    output_ir: float,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    require_columns(
        raw_data,
        (
            "dataset",
            "model",
            "output_ir",
            "block",
            "classifier",
            "metric",
            "mean",
        ),
        "tradeoff plot",
    )

    data = raw_data[
        raw_data["dataset"].isin(datasets)
        & raw_data["model"].isin(model_order)
        & np.isclose(raw_data["output_ir"].astype(float), output_ir)
    ].copy()
    index_columns = ("dataset", "model", "output_ir")

    utility = _pivot_metrics(
        data[
            (data["block"] == "utility_ml")
            & (data["classifier"] == classifier)
        ],
        ("tstr_aucroc", "tstr_auprc", "trtr_aucroc", "trtr_auprc"),
        index_columns,
    )
    mia = _pivot_metrics(
        data[data["block"] == "privacy_mia"],
        ("mia_auc", "mia_advantage"),
        index_columns,
    )
    nnaa = _pivot_metrics(
        data[data["block"] == "privacy_nnaa"],
        ("nnaa",),
        index_columns,
    )
    kanon = _pivot_metrics(
        data[data["block"] == "privacy_kanonymity"],
        ("kanon_k5_ratio",),
        index_columns,
    )

    relationships = utility.merge(
        mia,
        on=list(index_columns),
        how="outer",
    )
    relationships = relationships.merge(
        nnaa,
        on=list(index_columns),
        how="outer",
    )
    relationships = relationships.merge(
        kanon,
        on=list(index_columns),
        how="outer",
    )

    if relationships.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            "No tradeoff metrics were found for the selected parameters."
        )

    relationships["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(
        relationships["dataset"],
        categories=datasets,
        ordered=True,
    )
    relationships["model"] = pd.Categorical(
        relationships["model"],
        categories=model_order,
        ordered=True,
    )

    return relationships.sort_values(["dataset", "model", "output_ir"])


def tradeoff_output_basename(classifier: str, output_ir: float) -> str:
    ir_text = str(output_ir).replace(".", "_")
    return f"figure_trade_off_privacy_utility_ir{ir_text}_{classifier}"


def create_tradeoff_figure(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    datasets: tuple[str, ...],
    model_order: tuple[str, ...],
    classifier: str,
    output_ir: float,
    include_title: bool,
) -> Figure:
    datasets_to_plot = tuple(
        dataset
        for dataset in datasets
        if dataset in data["dataset"].dropna().astype(str).unique()
    )

    if not datasets_to_plot:
        raise ValueError("No valid datasets were found after filtering.")

    plt.rcParams.update(
        {
            "font.size": FONT_SIZES["default"],
            "font.family": "sans-serif",
            "axes.titlesize": FONT_SIZES["panel_title"],
            "axes.labelsize": FONT_SIZES["x_label"],
            "xtick.labelsize": FONT_SIZES["x_tick"],
            "ytick.labelsize": FONT_SIZES["y_tick"],
            "legend.fontsize": FONT_SIZES["model_legend"],
            "legend.title_fontsize": FONT_SIZES["model_legend_title"],
        }
    )

    figure, axes = plt.subplots(
        len(datasets_to_plot),
        len(PANEL_SPECS),
        figsize=(
            FIGURE_WIDTH,
            max(9, ROW_HEIGHT * len(datasets_to_plot)),
        ),
        sharex=False,
        sharey=False,
        squeeze=False,
    )

    for row_index, dataset in enumerate(datasets_to_plot):
        for column_index, panel in enumerate(PANEL_SPECS):
            ax = axes[row_index, column_index]
            subset = data[data["dataset"] == dataset]
            _plot_panel(ax, subset, panel, model_order)

            if dataset == "kidney_disease":
                _expand_x_axis(ax, KIDNEY_X_PADDING_RATIO)

            if row_index == 0:
                ax.set_title(
                    panel["title"],
                    fontsize=FONT_SIZES["panel_title"],
                    loc="center",
                    pad=PANEL_TITLE_PAD,
                    linespacing=PANEL_TITLE_LINE_SPACING,
                )

            if row_index == len(datasets_to_plot) - 1:
                ax.set_xlabel(
                    panel["xlabel"],
                    fontsize=FONT_SIZES["x_label"],
                )

            if column_index == 0:
                ax.set_ylabel(
                    dataset_label(dataset),
                    fontsize=FONT_SIZES["dataset_label"],
                )
            else:
                ax.set_ylabel("")

            ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=FONT_SIZES["x_tick"])
            ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=FONT_SIZES["y_tick"])

    model_handles = [
        Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            marker=MODEL_MARKERS[model],
            color="none",
            markerfacecolor=MODEL_COLORS[model],
            markeredgecolor="black",
            markeredgewidth=0.4,
            markersize=7.5,
            label=MODEL_LABELS[model],
        )
        for model in model_order
    ]
    reference_handles = [
        Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            color="#4A4A4A",
            linestyle="--",
            linewidth=0.9,
            label="TRTR utility baseline",
        ),
        Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            color="#7A7A7A",
            linestyle=":",
            linewidth=1.0,
            label="Privacy reference value",
        ),
    ]
    model_legend = figure.legend(
        handles=model_handles,
        loc="lower center",
        ncol=5,
        frameon=True,
        fancybox=True,
        fontsize=FONT_SIZES["model_legend"],
        title="Generative model color and marker code",
        title_fontsize=FONT_SIZES["model_legend_title"],
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, MODEL_LEGEND_Y),
        borderpad=0.8,
        columnspacing=1.4,
        handlelength=1.6,
    )
    figure.legend(
        handles=reference_handles,
        loc="lower center",
        ncol=2,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=FONT_SIZES["reference_legend"],
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, REFERENCE_LEGEND_Y),
        columnspacing=1.8,
        handlelength=2.2,
    )
    figure.add_artist(model_legend)

    if include_title:
        figure.suptitle(
            "Trade-off between downstream utility and privacy metrics"
            f" | IR = {output_ir}"
            f" | Classifier: {classifier_label(classifier)}",
            fontsize=FONT_SIZES["suptitle"],
            y=0.995,
        )

    figure.tight_layout(
        rect=[
            0,
            BOTTOM_LAYOUT_MARGIN,
            1,
            TOP_LAYOUT_MARGIN,
        ]
    )
    figure.subplots_adjust(wspace=COLUMN_SPACING)
    return figure


def _pivot_metrics(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: tuple[str, ...],
    index_columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    subset = data[data["metric"].isin(metrics)]

    if subset.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=list(index_columns) + list(metrics))

    pivoted = (
        subset.pivot_table(
            index=list(index_columns),
            columns="metric",
            values="mean",
            aggfunc="mean",
            observed=False,
        )
        .reset_index()
        .rename_axis(None, axis=1)
    )

    for metric in metrics:
        if metric not in pivoted.columns:
            pivoted[metric] = np.nan

    return pivoted


def _plot_panel(
    ax,
    subset: pd.DataFrame,
    panel: dict,
    model_order: tuple[str, ...],
) -> None:
    x_column = panel["xmetric"]
    y_column = panel["ymetric"]
    plot_data = subset.dropna(subset=[x_column, y_column]).copy()

    for model in model_order:
        model_data = plot_data[plot_data["model"] == model]

        if model_data.empty:
            continue

        ax.scatter(
            model_data[x_column],
            model_data[y_column],
            s=58,
            marker=MODEL_MARKERS[model],
            color=MODEL_COLORS[model],
            edgecolor="black",
            linewidth=0.4,
            alpha=0.90,
            label=MODEL_LABELS[model],
            zorder=3,
        )

    x_reference = _trtr_baseline(subset, panel["trtr_metric"])

    if np.isfinite(x_reference):
        ax.axvline(
            x_reference,
            color="#4A4A4A",
            linestyle="--",
            linewidth=0.9,
            zorder=1,
        )

    if panel["y_reference"] is not None:
        ax.axhline(
            panel["y_reference"],
            color="#7A7A7A",
            linestyle=":",
            linewidth=1.0,
            zorder=1,
        )

    x_min, x_max = _axis_limits(
        plot_data[x_column],
        reference_values=[x_reference],
        lower_bound=0.0,
        upper_bound=1.0,
    )

    if y_column in DYNAMIC_Y_AXIS_SETTINGS:
        settings = DYNAMIC_Y_AXIS_SETTINGS[y_column]
        y_min, y_max = _dynamic_y_limits(
            plot_data[y_column],
            settings["padding_ratio"],
            settings["below_zero_margin"],
        )
    else:
        y_min, y_max = _axis_limits(
            plot_data[y_column],
            reference_values=[panel["y_reference"]],
            lower_bound=0.0,
            upper_bound=1.0,
        )

    ax.set_xlim(x_min, x_max)
    ax.set_ylim(y_min, y_max)
    ax.grid(
        linestyle=":",
        linewidth=0.5,
        alpha=0.65,
        zorder=0,
    )


def _trtr_baseline(subset: pd.DataFrame, metric: str) -> float:
    values = finite_values(subset[metric])
    return float(np.mean(values)) if len(values) else np.nan


def _axis_limits(
    values,
    reference_values=None,
    lower_bound: Optional[float] = None,
    upper_bound: Optional[float] = None,
) -> tuple[float, float]:
    finite = finite_values(values)

    if reference_values is not None:
        references = finite_values(reference_values)
        finite = np.concatenate([finite, references])

    if not len(finite):
        return 0.0, 1.0

    value_min = float(np.min(finite))
    value_max = float(np.max(finite))

    if np.isclose(value_min, value_max):
        margin = 0.01 if value_max == 0 else abs(value_max) * 0.01
        value_min -= margin
        value_max += margin

    span = value_max - value_min
    padding = 0.04 * span if span > 0 else 0.01
    value_min -= padding
    value_max += padding

    if lower_bound is not None:
        value_min = max(lower_bound, value_min)

    if upper_bound is not None:
        value_max = min(upper_bound, value_max)

    return value_min, value_max


def _dynamic_y_limits(
    values,
    padding_ratio: float,
    below_zero_margin: float,
) -> tuple[float, float]:
    finite = finite_values(values)

    if not len(finite):
        return -below_zero_margin, 1.0

    data_min = float(np.min(finite))
    data_max = float(np.max(finite))
    span = data_max - data_min

    if np.isclose(span, 0.0):
        span = max(abs(data_max), 0.01)

    padding = padding_ratio * span
    y_min = min(data_min - padding, -below_zero_margin)
    y_max = data_max + padding

    if np.isclose(y_min, y_max):
        y_max = y_min + 0.01

    return y_min, y_max


def _expand_x_axis(ax, padding_ratio: float) -> None:
    x_min, x_max = ax.get_xlim()
    span = x_max - x_min

    if not np.isfinite(span) or span <= 0:
        return

    padding = padding_ratio * span
    ax.set_xlim(x_min - padding, x_max + padding)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.figure import Figure
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

from src.plots.common import draw_family_bands, finite_values, style_boxplot
from src.plots.data import require_columns
from src.plots.styles import (
    MODEL_COLORS,
    MODEL_FAMILIES,
    MODEL_LABELS,
    classifier_label,
    dataset_label,
)

METRICS = ("aucroc", "auprc", "f1")

METRIC_LABELS = {
    "aucroc": "AUC-ROC",
    "auprc": "AUC-PRC",
    "f1": "F1-score",
}

METRIC_DIRECTIONS = {
    "aucroc": "↑",
    "auprc": "↑",
    "f1": "↑",
}

FONT_SIZES = {
    "default": 14,
    "suptitle": 19,
    "subplot_title": 17,
    "dataset_label": 14,
    "x_tick": 14,
    "y_tick": 14,
    "model_legend": 15,
    "model_legend_title": 16,
    "family_legend": 14,
    "family_legend_title": 15,
}


def build_utility_table(
    raw_data: pd.DataFrame,
    datasets: tuple[str, ...],
    model_order: tuple[str, ...],
    classifier: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    require_columns(
        raw_data,
        (
            "dataset",
            "block",
            "classifier",
            "model",
            "metric",
            "mean",
            "output_ir",
        ),
        "utility plot",
    )

    valid_metrics = [f"tstr_{metric}" for metric in METRICS]
    data = raw_data[
        raw_data["dataset"].isin(datasets)
        & (raw_data["block"] == "utility_ml")
        & (raw_data["classifier"] == classifier)
        & raw_data["model"].isin(model_order)
        & raw_data["metric"].isin(valid_metrics)
    ].copy()

    if data.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            "No utility metrics were found for the selected parameters."
        )

    data["metric_base"] = data["metric"].str.replace(
        r"^tstr_",
        "",
        regex=True,
    )
    data["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(
        data["dataset"],
        categories=datasets,
        ordered=True,
    )
    data["model"] = pd.Categorical(
        data["model"],
        categories=model_order,
        ordered=True,
    )
    data["metric_base"] = pd.Categorical(
        data["metric_base"],
        categories=METRICS,
        ordered=True,
    )

    return data.sort_values(
        ["dataset", "metric_base", "model", "output_ir"]
    )


def utility_output_basename(classifier: str) -> str:
    return f"figure_utility_profiles_tstr_only_taxonomy_{classifier}"


def create_utility_figure(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    datasets: tuple[str, ...],
    model_order: tuple[str, ...],
    classifier: str,
    include_title: bool,
) -> Figure:
    datasets_to_plot = tuple(
        dataset
        for dataset in datasets
        if dataset in data["dataset"].dropna().astype(str).unique()
    )

    if not datasets_to_plot:
        raise ValueError("No valid datasets were found after filtering.")

    plt.rcParams.update(
        {
            "font.size": FONT_SIZES["default"],
            "font.family": "sans-serif",
            "axes.titlesize": FONT_SIZES["subplot_title"],
            "axes.labelsize": FONT_SIZES["dataset_label"],
            "xtick.labelsize": FONT_SIZES["x_tick"],
            "ytick.labelsize": FONT_SIZES["y_tick"],
            "legend.fontsize": FONT_SIZES["model_legend"],
            "legend.title_fontsize": FONT_SIZES["model_legend_title"],
        }
    )

    figure, axes = plt.subplots(
        len(datasets_to_plot),
        len(METRICS),
        figsize=(15, max(8, 3.0 * len(datasets_to_plot))),
        sharex=True,
        sharey=False,
        squeeze=False,
    )
    positions = np.arange(len(model_order))

    for row_index, dataset in enumerate(datasets_to_plot):
        for column_index, metric in enumerate(METRICS):
            ax = axes[row_index, column_index]
            subset = data[
                (data["dataset"] == dataset)
                & (data["metric_base"] == metric)
            ]

            draw_family_bands(ax, model_order)
            values = [
                _boxplot_values(subset, model)
                for model in model_order
            ]
            boxplot = ax.boxplot(
                values,
                positions=positions,
                widths=0.45,
                patch_artist=True,
                showfliers=False,
                manage_ticks=False,
            )
            style_boxplot(boxplot, model_order)

            y_min, y_max = _subplot_limits(subset)
            ax.set_ylim(y_min, y_max)

        title_fontsize=FONT_SIZES["family_legend_title"],
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.01),

            f"Classifier: {classifier_label(classifier)}",
            fontsize=FONT_SIZES["suptitle"],

def _boxplot_values(subset: pd.DataFrame, model: str) -> np.ndarray:
    values = finite_values(subset[subset["model"] == model]["mean"])
    return values if len(values) else np.array([np.nan])


def _subplot_limits(subset: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[float, float]:
    values = finite_values(subset["mean"])

    if not len(values):
        return 0.0, 1.0

    y_min = float(np.min(values))
    y_max = float(np.max(values))

    if np.isclose(y_min, y_max):
        margin = 0.01 if y_max == 0 else abs(y_max) * 0.01
        y_min = max(0.0, y_min - margin)
        y_max = min(1.0, y_max + margin)

    return y_min, y_max

"""Isolated A1 preparation: source-only groups, train-only statistics, no models.

Only the standard library is required. Decimal preserves observed numeric values
when grouping; float64 is used only for the exported matrices, without scaling.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import math
import random
import statistics
import struct
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Sequence

Cell = Decimal | None
Row = tuple[Cell, ...]


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def encode(value: Any) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()


def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(encode(value))


def canonical(value: Cell) -> str | None:
    # Decimal equality treats 1, 1.0 and 1e0 identically, without rounding.
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = format(value, "f")
    return "0" if value == 0 else text.rstrip("0").rstrip(".") if "." in text else text


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SourceData:
    names: tuple[str, ...]
    X: tuple[Row, ...]
    y: tuple[int, ...]
    row_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    group_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    source_hash: str
    audit: dict[str, Any]


def load_source(path: Path, spec: dict[str, Any]) -> SourceData:
    """Read only the explicit source path; reject schema or missing surprises."""
    source_hash = digest(path)
    mapping = spec["column_mapping"]
    names = tuple(v for v in mapping.values() if v != "class")
    if set(names) != set(spec["types"]) or len(set(mapping.values())) != len(mapping):
        raise ValueError("Invalid explicit schema")
    X: list[Row] = []
    y: list[int] = []
    row_ids: list[str] = []
    group_ids: list[str] = []
    missing = Counter()
    tokens = Counter()
    zeros = Counter()
    with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as stream:
        reader = csv.reader(stream, delimiter=",")
        if next(reader) != list(mapping):
            raise ValueError(f"Header mismatch: {path.name}; no data row was discarded")
        for position, fields in enumerate(reader, 1):
            if len(fields) != len(mapping):
                raise ValueError(f"Malformed source row {position}")
            record = dict(zip(mapping, fields))
            target = Decimal(record[spec["source_target"]])
            if target not in (0, 1):
                raise ValueError(f"Unexpected target at source row {position}")
            values: list[Cell] = []
            for original, name in mapping.items():
                if name == "class":
                    continue
                token = record[original]
                if token in spec["missing_tokens"]:
                    value = None
                    tokens[token] += 1
                else:
                    if not token.strip():
                        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected blank: {name}, row {position}")
                    value = Decimal(token)
                    if not value.is_finite():
                        raise ValueError(f"Nonfinite source: {name}, row {position}")
                    if value == 0:
                        zeros[name] += 1
                        if name in spec["zero_as_missing"]:
                            value = None
                kind = spec["types"][name]
                if value is not None:
                    if kind == "binary" and value not in (0, 1):
                        raise ValueError(f"Invalid binary: {name}, row {position}")
                    if kind == "count" and (value < 0 or value != value.to_integral_value()):
                        raise ValueError(f"Invalid count: {name}, row {position}")
                    if name in spec["categorical_domains"] and value not in spec["categorical_domains"][name]:
                        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected category: {name}, row {position}")
                else:
                    missing[name] += 1
                values.append(value)
            row = tuple(values)
            group = hashlib.sha256(encode([names, [canonical(v) for v in row]])).hexdigest()
            X.append(row)
            y.append(int(target))
            row_ids.append(f"{path.name}:{source_hash}:row_{position}")
            group_ids.append(group)
    labels: dict[str, set[int]] = defaultdict(set)
    for group, target in zip(group_ids, y):
        labels[group].add(target)
    conflicts = [g for g, targets in labels.items() if len(targets) != 1]
    if conflicts:
        raise ValueError(f"Contradictory targets in {len(conflicts)} predictor groups; preparation stopped")
    return SourceData(names, tuple(X), tuple(y), tuple(row_ids), tuple(group_ids), source_hash, {
        "source_rows": len(X), "source_groups": len(labels),
        "repeated_rows_extra": len(X) - len(labels), "conflicting_groups": 0,
        "class_counts": dict(Counter(y)), "missing_by_column": dict(missing),
        "missing_tokens": dict(tokens), "zero_counts_before_missing": dict(zeros),
        "source_row_position": "one-based data record, excluding header",
        "subject_id": "No explicit subject identifier in the authorized schema",
    })


def split_groups(data: SourceData, seed: int, fraction: float) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
    """Find nearest reachable test row count independently per class.

    Shuffle sorted group hashes using Random(seed), then subset-sum by group size.
    Each reachable sum retains its first predecessor; ties prefer fewer test rows.
    Target counts use half-up rounding. Both partitions must retain each class.
    No features beyond group identity, fitted statistics or outcomes are scored.
    """
    groups: dict[str, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
    for i, group in enumerate(data.group_ids):
        groups[group].append(i)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    test_groups: set[str] = set()
    for label in (0, 1):
        candidates = sorted(g for g, ids in groups.items() if data.y[ids[0]] == label)
        rng.shuffle(candidates)
        n = sum(len(groups[g]) for g in candidates)
        wanted = math.floor(n * fraction + 0.5)
        reachable = 1
        predecessors: dict[int, tuple[int, str]] = {}
        for group in candidates:
            size = len(groups[group])
            shifted = reachable << size
            new = shifted & ~reachable
            while new:
                bit = new & -new
                total = bit.bit_length() - 1
                predecessors[total] = (total - size, group)
                new -= bit
            reachable |= shifted
        possible = [i for i in range(1, n) if (reachable >> i) & 1]
        if not possible:
            raise ValueError(f"Class {label} cannot appear on both sides of a group split")
        total = min(possible, key=lambda i: (abs(i - wanted), i))
        while total:
            total, group = predecessors[total]
            test_groups.add(group)
    train = [i for i, g in enumerate(data.group_ids) if g not in test_groups]
    test = [i for i, g in enumerate(data.group_ids) if g in test_groups]
    return train, test


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Preprocessor:
    """JSON-serializable fitted object; fit and transform have no target input."""

    names: tuple[str, ...]
    kept: tuple[str, ...]
    missing_counts: dict[str, int]
    missing_fractions: dict[str, float]
    fill_values: dict[str, str]
    strategies: dict[str, str]
    train_categories: dict[str, list[str]]

    @classmethod
    def fit(cls, X_train: Sequence[Row], names: tuple[str, ...],
            types: dict[str, str], threshold: float | None) -> Preprocessor:
        if not X_train:
            raise ValueError("Empty train")
        kept: list[str] = []
        counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        fractions: dict[str, float] = {}
        fills: dict[str, str] = {}
        strategies: dict[str, str] = {}
        categories: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for j, name in enumerate(names):
            observed = [r[j] for r in X_train if r[j] is not None]
            counts[name] = len(X_train) - len(observed)
            fractions[name] = counts[name] / len(X_train)
            if threshold is not None and fractions[name] >= threshold:
                continue
            if not observed:
                raise ValueError(f"Entirely missing train column outside drop rule: {name}")
            kept.append(name)
            if types[name] in ("binary", "categorical"):
                frequency = Counter(observed)
                value = min(v for v, n in frequency.items() if n == max(frequency.values()))
                strategies[name] = "mode_smallest_numeric_tie"
                categories[name] = [canonical(v) for v in sorted(frequency)]
            else:
                value = statistics.median(observed)
                strategies[name] = "median_fraction_preserved"
            fills[name] = str(value)
        return cls(names, tuple(kept), counts, fractions, fills, strategies, categories)

    def transform(self, X: Sequence[Row]) -> list[list[float]]:
        indices = [self.names.index(c) for c in self.kept]
        return [[float(row[j] if row[j] is not None else Decimal(self.fill_values[c]))
                 for c, j in zip(self.kept, indices)] for row in X]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, value: dict[str, Any]) -> Preprocessor:
        return cls(**{**value, "names": tuple(value["names"]), "kept": tuple(value["kept"])})


def npy_bytes(values: Sequence[Any], matrix: bool) -> bytes:
    """NumPy NPY v1.0, little-endian float64 matrices / int32 labels, C order."""
    shape = (len(values), len(values[0])) if matrix else (len(values),)
    header = repr({"descr": "<f8" if matrix else "<i4", "fortran_order": False, "shape": shape})
    padding = (16 - (10 + len(header) + 1) % 16) % 16
    encoded = (header + " " * padding + "\n").encode("ascii")
    flat = [v for row in values for v in row] if matrix else list(values)
    return b"\x93NUMPY\x01\x00" + struct.pack("<H", len(encoded)) + encoded + struct.pack(
        "<" + ("d" if matrix else "i") * len(flat), *flat)


def read_npy(path: Path) -> list[Any]:
    """Read back the restricted NPY format without importing NumPy."""
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        if stream.read(8) != b"\x93NUMPY\x01\x00":
            raise ValueError("Unexpected NPY version")
        size = struct.unpack("<H", stream.read(2))[0]
        header = ast.literal_eval(stream.read(size).decode("ascii"))
        shape = header["shape"]
        kind = {"<f8": "d", "<i4": "i"}[header["descr"]]
        flat = [v[0] for v in struct.iter_unpack("<" + kind, stream.read())]
        if math.prod(shape) != len(flat) or header["fortran_order"]:
            raise ValueError("Invalid NPY payload")
        return [flat[i:i + shape[1]] for i in range(0, len(flat), shape[1])] if len(shape) == 2 else flat


def checks(data: SourceData, spec: dict[str, Any], seed: int, fraction: float,
           train: list[int], test: list[int], prep: Preprocessor,
           X_train: list[list[float]], X_test: list[list[float]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Independent statistics and fixed-split intervention checks, without fits of models."""
    passed: dict[str, bool] = {}
    passed["disjoint_source_rows"] = not set(train) & set(test)
    passed["all_source_rows_preserved"] = sorted(train + test) == list(range(len(data.X)))
    passed["disjoint_groups"] = not {data.group_ids[i] for i in train} & {data.group_ids[i] for i in test}
    passed["both_classes"] = all({data.y[i] for i in ids} == {0, 1} for ids in (train, test))
    train_raw = [data.X[i] for i in train]
    test_raw = [data.X[i] for i in test]
    # Independent implementation: sorted middle values and sorted frequency pairs.
    independent = True
    for j, name in enumerate(data.names):
        values = sorted(r[j] for r in train_raw if r[j] is not None)
        n_missing = len(train) - len(values)
        independent &= prep.missing_counts[name] == n_missing
        independent &= prep.missing_fractions[name] == n_missing / len(train)
        drop = spec["drop_missing_threshold"] is not None and n_missing / len(train) >= spec["drop_missing_threshold"]
        independent &= (name not in prep.kept) == drop
        if drop:
            continue
        if spec["types"][name] in ("binary", "categorical"):
            expected = sorted(Counter(values).items(), key=lambda p: (-p[1], p[0]))[0][0]
        else:
            mid = len(values) // 2
            expected = values[mid] if len(values) % 2 else (values[mid - 1] + values[mid]) / 2
        independent &= Decimal(prep.fill_values[name]) == expected
    passed["independent_train_statistics"] = independent
    # A label-bearing evaluation wrapper is exercised with three different targets;
    # transform itself cannot accept targets, so none can choose a class imputor.
    def evaluation_view(labels: list[int]) -> tuple[list[list[float]], list[int]]:
        return prep.transform(test_raw), labels
    labels = [data.y[i] for i in test]
    shuffled = labels.copy()
    random.Random(seed).shuffle(shuffled)
    passed["test_labels_flipped_invariance"] = evaluation_view([1 - v for v in labels])[0] == X_test
    passed["test_labels_shuffled_invariance"] = evaluation_view(shuffled)[0] == X_test
    # Intervention is on the full predictor collection with row membership fixed.
    intervened = list(data.X)
    for i in test:
        intervened[i] = tuple(None if j % 2 else Decimal(100000 + j) for j in range(len(data.names)))
    other = Preprocessor.fit([intervened[i] for i in train], data.names,
                             spec["types"], spec["drop_missing_threshold"])
    passed["test_predictors_do_not_change_fit"] = other.to_dict() == prep.to_dict()
    passed["test_predictors_do_not_change_train"] = other.transform([intervened[i] for i in train]) == X_train
    passed["aligned_finite_matrices"] = bool(prep.kept) and all(
        len(row) == len(prep.kept) and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in row)
        for row in X_train + X_test)
    train2, test2 = split_groups(data, seed, fraction)
    prep2 = Preprocessor.fit([data.X[i] for i in train2], data.names,
                             spec["types"], spec["drop_missing_threshold"])
    passed["repeat_partition"] = (train2, test2) == (train, test)
    passed["repeat_fit_and_values"] = prep2.to_dict() == prep.to_dict() and (
        prep2.transform([data.X[i] for i in train2]) == X_train
        and prep2.transform([data.X[i] for i in test2]) == X_test)
    train_keys = Counter(tuple(r) for r in X_train)
    test_keys = Counter(tuple(r) for r in X_test)
    overlap = train_keys.keys() & test_keys.keys()
    return {"checks": passed, "passed": all(passed.values()), "failures": [k for k, v in passed.items() if not v],
            "postprocessing_overlap": {"unique_predictor_patterns": len(overlap),
                "test_rows_matching_train": sum(test_keys[k] for k in overlap),
                "train_rows_matching_test": sum(train_keys[k] for k in overlap)}}


def prepare(data: SourceData, spec: dict[str, Any], seed: int,
            fraction: float) -> tuple[dict[str, bytes], dict[str, Any]]:
    train, test = split_groups(data, seed, fraction)
    prep = Preprocessor.fit([data.X[i] for i in train], data.names,
                            spec["types"], spec["drop_missing_threshold"])
    X_train = prep.transform([data.X[i] for i in train])
    X_test = prep.transform([data.X[i] for i in test])
    verification = checks(data, spec, seed, fraction, train, test, prep, X_train, X_test)
    if not verification["passed"]:
        raise ValueError(f"Verification failures: {verification['failures']}")
    partitions = {side: [{"matrix_row": j, "source_position": i + 1,
                         "row_id": data.row_ids[i], "group_id": data.group_ids[i]}
                        for j, i in enumerate(ids)] for side, ids in (("train", train), ("test", test))}
    summary: dict[str, Any] = {"seed": seed, "source_sha256": data.source_hash,
        "feature_names": list(prep.kept), "dropped_columns": [c for c in data.names if c not in prep.kept],
        "split_method": "classwise_subset_sum_v1; nearest reachable class row quotas; approximate stratification",
        "requested_test_fraction": fraction, "effective_test_fraction": len(test) / len(data.X),
        "n_source": len(data.X), "n_source_groups": len(set(data.group_ids)),
        "n_features": len(prep.kept), "postprocessing_overlap": verification["postprocessing_overlap"]}
    artifacts: dict[str, bytes] = {"preprocessing.json": encode(prep.to_dict()),
        "partition.json": encode(partitions), "verification.json": encode(verification),
        "schema.json": encode(spec), "source_audit.json": encode(data.audit)}
    for side, ids, matrix in (("train", train, X_train), ("test", test, X_test)):
        summary[side] = {"rows": len(ids), "groups": len({data.group_ids[i] for i in ids}),
            "class_counts": dict(Counter(data.y[i] for i in ids)),
            "class_proportions": {k: sum(data.y[i] == k for i in ids) / len(ids) for k in (0, 1)},
            "missing_before_selection": sum(v is None for i in ids for v in data.X[i]),
            "missing_before_imputation_kept": sum(data.X[i][data.names.index(c)] is None for i in ids for c in prep.kept),
            "missing_after": 0}
        artifacts[f"X_{side}.npy"] = npy_bytes(matrix, True)
        artifacts[f"y_{side}.npy"] = npy_bytes([data.y[i] for i in ids], False)
    summary["fractional_count_imputers"] = [c for c in prep.kept if spec["types"][c] == "count"
        and Decimal(prep.fill_values[c]) != Decimal(prep.fill_values[c]).to_integral_value()]
    artifacts["feature_meta.json"] = encode(summary)
    return artifacts, summary


def verify_saved(directory: Path, expected: dict[str, bytes], data: SourceData) -> None:
    manifest = json.loads(directory.joinpath("artifact_hashes.json").read_text())
    if set(manifest) != set(expected):
        raise ValueError("Artifact inventory mismatch")
    for name, payload in expected.items():
        path = directory.joinpath(name)
        if path.read_bytes() != payload or digest(path) != manifest[name]:
            raise ValueError(f"Artifact/reproduction mismatch: {name}")
    prep = Preprocessor.from_dict(json.loads(directory.joinpath("preprocessing.json").read_text()))
    partitions = json.loads(directory.joinpath("partition.json").read_text())
    for side in ("train", "test"):
        matrix = read_npy(directory.joinpath(f"X_{side}.npy"))
        labels = read_npy(directory.joinpath(f"y_{side}.npy"))
        if len(matrix) != len(labels) or any(len(r) != len(prep.kept) for r in matrix):
            raise ValueError("Serialized matrix shape mismatch")
        ids = [r["source_position"] - 1 for r in partitions[side]]
        if prep.transform([data.X[i] for i in ids]) != matrix or [data.y[i] for i in ids] != labels:
            raise ValueError("Reloaded preprocessing object/matrices mismatch")

"""No-training evidence: real NumPy/geometry, simulated generators/classifiers."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import json
import tempfile
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.neighbors import BallTree
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

from config.const import ROOT_DIR, SUPPORTED_MODELS, REVISION_A1_SOURCE_FILES
from src.revision_a1 import canonical, digest, encode, prepare, verify_saved
from src.revision_a1_runtime import (RevisedRun, array_record, evaluate_split, frame_record,
                                     generator_inputs, require, sample_split, value_hash)


def overlap_record(train, test, train_y, test_y):
    common = set(train) & set(test)
    train_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(train) if row in common]
    test_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(test) if row in common]
    return {"shared_patterns": len(common), "train_rows": len(train_rows), "test_rows": len(test_rows),
            "train_classes": dict(Counter(str(train_y[i]) for i in train_rows)),
            "test_classes": dict(Counter(str(test_y[i]) for i in test_rows)),
            "patterns": [{"pattern_sha256": value_hash(row),
                          "train_classes": dict(Counter(str(train_y[i]) for i, r in enumerate(train) if r == row)),
                          "test_classes": dict(Counter(str(test_y[i]) for i, r in enumerate(test) if r == row))}
                         for row in sorted(common, key=repr)]}


def overlap_stages(split):
    source, prep = split.source, split.preprocessing
    indices = [source.names.index(c) for c in prep.kept]
    stages = {}
    for stage in ("original_normalized", "after_column_selection", "after_imputation"):
        sides = []
        for side in ("train", "test"):
            rows = [source.X[r["source_position"] - 1] for r in split.partition[side]]
            if stage == "after_imputation":
                patterns = [tuple(row) for row in getattr(split, f"X_{side}").tolist()]
            else:
                keep = range(len(source.names)) if stage == "original_normalized" else indices
                patterns = [tuple(canonical(row[i]) for i in keep) for row in rows]
            sides.append(patterns)
        stages[stage] = overlap_record(*sides, split.y_train, split.y_test)
    return stages


def geometry(split):
    from src.evaluation.privacy import compute_dcr_holdout, compute_kanonymity
    train = pd.DataFrame(split.X_train, columns=split.names)
    test = pd.DataFrame(split.X_test, columns=split.names)
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaled_train = scaler.fit_transform(train.fillna(0))
    tree = BallTree(scaled_train, metric="euclidean")
    distances = tree.query(scaler.transform(test.fillna(0)), k=1)[0][:, 0]
    percentile = float(np.percentile(distances, 25))
    # Test rows serve solely as geometric query probes; they are not synthetic data.
    rows = compute_dcr_holdout(test, train)
    kanon = compute_kanonymity(test, train, test)
    actual = {r["metric"]: r["value"] for r in rows + kanon}
    require(actual["dcr_holdout_mean"] == float(distances.mean()), "DCR implementation mismatch")
    require(actual["kanon_epsilon"] == (percentile if percentile > 0 else 1e-6), "Radius mismatch")
    return {"distance_sha256": array_record(distances), "zero_distance_test_rows": int((distances == 0).sum()),
            "zero_distance_test_classes": dict(Counter(str(y) for y in split.y_test[distances == 0])),
            "epsilon_p25_before_fallback": percentile, "fallback_used": percentile <= 0,
            "epsilon_p25_without_zero_rows": float(np.percentile(distances[distances > 0], 25)),
            "holdout_mean_without_zero_rows": float(distances[distances > 0].mean()),
            "actual_metrics_on_real_query_probes": actual}


def zero_geometry_probe():
    from src.evaluation.privacy import compute_dcr_holdout, compute_kanonymity
    train = pd.DataFrame({"feature": [0., 0., 0., 0., 0.]})
    test = pd.DataFrame({"feature": [0., 0.]})
    rows = compute_dcr_holdout(test, train) + compute_kanonymity(test, train, test)
    metrics = {r["metric"]: r["value"] for r in rows}
    require(metrics["kanon_epsilon"] == 1e-6 and metrics["dcr_holdout_mean"] == 0,
            "Zero fallback behavior changed")
    from src.plots.privacy import build_privacy_table
    probes = []
    for numerator in (0., 1.):
        records = [{"dataset": "fixture", "model": "fixture", "output_ir": 1.,
                    "block": "privacy_dcr", "metric": metric, "mean": value}
                   for metric, value in (("dcr_mean", numerator), ("dcr_holdout_mean", 0.))]
        ratio = build_privacy_table(pd.DataFrame(records), ("fixture",), ("fixture",))["ratio_dcr_mean"].iloc[0]
        require(pd.isna(ratio), "Zero DCR denominator handling changed")
        probes.append({"numerator": numerator, "denominator": 0., "ratio": "NaN"})
    return {"metrics": metrics, "actual_plot_ratio_probes": probes}


class FixtureGenerator:
    """A fixture replayer, never a learned model or a synthetic-data result."""
    def __init__(self, expected, records):
        self.expected = expected
        self.records = records

    def fit(self, frame, model_dir):
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(frame, self.expected, check_exact=True)
        self.frame = frame.copy()
        self.records.append({"fit": frame_record(frame)})
        model_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def sample(self, n, model_dir):
        if "__target__" in self.frame:
            parts = []
            for label in (0, 1):
                rows = self.frame.loc[self.frame["__target__"] == label].drop(columns="__target__")
                frame = rows.iloc[np.arange(n) % len(rows)].reset_index(drop=True)
                frame["__label__"] = np.full(n, label, dtype="<i4")
                parts.append(frame)
            return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)
        return self.frame.iloc[np.arange(n) % len(self.frame)].reset_index(drop=True)


def simulated_flow(run, split, model, base):
    import main_evaluator as evaluator
    from src.evaluation import utility
    expected = generator_inputs(split, model)
    fit_records = []
    classifier_records = []
    factories = iter(frame for _, frame in expected)

    def factory(name, params):
        from src.revision_generator_parameters import parameter_plan
        effective = parameter_plan(model, run.config["model_params"][model], split.seed)["effective_wrapper_parameters"]
        if model in ('ctgan', 'copulagan', 'tvae', 'gaussian_copula'):
            # The approved contract adds shared semantic types after generic parameter
            # migration. Reconstruct that addition independently; keep full equality.
            from src.revision_sdv import schema_record
            effective['_revision_parameters']['sdv_semantic_schema'] = schema_record(
                split.names, run.policy['datasets'][split.dataset]['types'])
        require(name == model and params == effective, "Generator parameters mismatch")
        return FixtureGenerator(next(factories), fit_records)

    def classifier(clf, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test, clf_name, mode, save_path=None):
        require(np.array_equal(X_test, split.X_test) and np.array_equal(y_test, split.y_test), "Classifier test changed")
        if mode == "trtr":
            require(np.array_equal(X_train, split.X_train) and np.array_equal(y_train, split.y_train), "TRTR train changed")
        else:
            require(set(np.unique(y_train)) == {0, 1} and X_train.shape[1] == len(split.names), "TSTR schema changed")
            require(np.array_equal(X_train, expected_final["frame"][split.names].to_numpy()) and
                    np.array_equal(y_train, expected_final["frame"]["class"].to_numpy()), "TSTR data changed")
        classifier_records.append({"mode": mode, "X_train": array_record(X_train), "y_train": array_record(y_train),
                                   "X_test": array_record(X_test), "y_test": array_record(y_test)})
        return []

    stubbed = ("compute_detectability", "compute_univariate", "compute_multivariate", "compute_exact_matches",
               "compute_dcr", "compute_dcr_holdout", "compute_mia", "compute_attribute_inference",
               "compute_nnaa", "compute_kanonymity")
    from contextlib import ExitStack
    expected_final = {}
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        stack.enter_context(patch("src.revision_a1_runtime.MODELS_DIR", base / "models"))
        stack.enter_context(patch("src.revision_a1_runtime.RESULTS_DIR", base / "results"))
        for name in stubbed:
            def recorder(*args, _name=name, **kwargs):
                for frame in args:
                    if isinstance(frame, pd.DataFrame):
                        columns = list(frame.columns)
                        target_expected = _name == "compute_attribute_inference"
                        require(columns == split.names + (["class"] if target_expected else []), "Privacy/metric input schema changed")
                return []
            recorder.__name__ = name
            stack.enter_context(patch.object(evaluator, name, recorder))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(utility, "_get_classifiers", lambda seed: {"simulated": object()}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(utility, "_evaluate_classifier", classifier))
        sample_split(run, split, model, factory)
        output = run.paths(split, model)[2]
        from src.revision_a1_runtime import load_samples
        from src.evaluation.builder import build_synthetic_dataset
        samples = load_samples(run, split, model)
        majority = int(np.argmax(np.bincount(split.y_train)))
        expected_final["frame"] = build_synthetic_dataset(samples[majority], samples[1-majority], 1.,
                                                          split.seed, majority, 1-majority)
        evaluate_split(run, split, model, [1.0], evaluator._evaluate_combination, logging.getLogger("a1-audit"))
        evidence = json.loads((output / "metrics/input_hashes.json").read_text())
        sample_manifest = json.loads((output / "samples_manifest.json").read_text())
    require(len(classifier_records) == 2, "TRTR/TSTR dispatch missing")
    return {"model": model, "kind": "simulated generator + classifier + privacy/statistical metrics",
            "generator_fit": fit_records, "classifier_arrays": classifier_records,
            "sample_csv_hashes": sample_manifest["files"], "metric_dispatch": evidence["calls"]}


def audit(run, *, simulate=True):
    code_paths = ("src/revision_a1_runtime.py", "src/revision_a1_audit.py", "main_check_revision_a1.py",
                  "main_sampler.py", "main_evaluator.py", "src/plots/privacy.py")
    before_code = {p: digest(ROOT_DIR / p) for p in code_paths}
    reports, diversity = [], {}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="a1-simulated-") as temporary:
        for dataset in run.policy["datasets"]:
            tests = []
            for seed in run.policy["seeds"]:
                split = run.load(dataset, seed)
                # Audit-only reproduction; production consumers never split or fit preprocessing.
                expected, _ = prepare(split.source, run.policy["datasets"][dataset], seed, run.policy["test_fraction"])
                expected["provenance.json"] = encode(run.manifest["identity"])
                verify_saved(run.directory / dataset / f"seed_{seed}", expected, split.source)
                test_ids = sorted(r["row_id"] for r in split.partition["test"])
                tests.append((seed, value_hash(test_ids), set(test_ids)))
                item = {"dataset": dataset, "seed": seed, "verified": True, "audit_only_preparation_reproduced": True,
                        "arrays": {name: array_record(getattr(split, name)) for name in ("X_train", "X_test", "y_train", "y_test")},
                        "columns": split.names, "artifact_hashes": split.artifact_hashes,
                        "partition_sha256": value_hash(split.partition), "test_set_sha256": value_hash(test_ids),
                        "overlap_stages": overlap_stages(split), "geometry": geometry(split)}
                if simulate:
                    item["simulated_flow"] = [simulated_flow(run, split, model, Path(temporary))
                                              for model in SUPPORTED_MODELS if model != "forestdiffusion"]
                    item["blocked_forestdiffusion_input"] = [frame_record(f) for _, f in
                                                               generator_inputs(split, "forestdiffusion", diagnostic=True)]
                reports.append(item)
            diversity[dataset] = {"distinct_test_sets": len({h for _, h, _ in tests}),
                                  "seed_hashes": {str(s): h for s, h, _ in tests},
                                  "pairwise_shared_test_rows": [{"seeds": [a[0], b[0]], "rows": len(a[2] & b[2])}
                                                                for i, a in enumerate(tests) for b in tests[i+1:]]}
    sources_after = {name: digest(path) for name, path in REVISION_A1_SOURCE_FILES.items()}
    require(sources_after == run.manifest["sources_before"], "Sources changed during audit")
    require(before_code == {p: digest(ROOT_DIR / p) for p in code_paths}, "Code changed during audit")
    return {"run_id": run.run_id, "runtime": run.runtime, "sources_after": sources_after,
            "preparation_runtime": run.manifest["dependencies"],
            "training_performed": False, "simulated": simulate,
            "verified_combinations": len(reports), "split_diversity": diversity, "combinations": reports,
            "zero_distance_fixture_real_metrics": zero_geometry_probe(),
            "code_sha256": before_code,
            "limitations": ["Generator libraries were not fitted or sampled; wrapper internal/library behavior remains unverified at runtime.",
                            "Only geometric privacy metrics ran with real implementations; query probes are real rows.",
                            "ForestDiffusion actual execution is blocked; its full-data input contract is diagnostic only."]}
