def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def comparison(a, b):
    a, b = np.asarray(a), np.asarray(b)
    same_shape = a.shape == b.shape
    return {"same_shape": same_shape, "same_dtype": a.dtype == b.dtype,
            "exact_equal": bool(same_shape and np.array_equal(a, b)),
            "different_cells": int(np.count_nonzero(a != b)) if same_shape else None,
            "max_absolute_difference": float(np.max(np.abs(a-b))) if same_shape and a.size else None,
            "tolerance": 0}


def technical_fixture():
    frame = pd.DataFrame({"binary": [0., 1.]*6, "category_three": [10., 30., 90.]*4,
                          "constant_middle": pd.Series([7]*12, dtype="int16"),
                          "count": [.5, 1.5, 2., 3., 4., 5., 2., 1., .5, 5.5, 4., 3.],
                          "category_two": [-7., 22.]*6,
                          "continuous": [-.2, .1, .35, .6, .8, 1.2, 1.7, 2.1, .4, 1.1, 2.5, 3.]})
    types = dict(zip(frame, ("binary", "categorical", "count", "count", "categorical", "continuous")))
    return frame, types


def cases_for(run, split):
    result = []
    for label, size in ((0, 32), (1, 44)):
        positions = np.flatnonzero(split.y_train == label)[:size]
        require(len(positions) == size, "Unexpected Cervical class size")
        frame = pd.DataFrame(split.X_train[positions].copy(), columns=split.names)
        result.append({"name": f"cervical_class_{label}", "label": label, "frame": frame,
                       "types": run.policy["datasets"][split.dataset]["types"],
                       "dataset": split.dataset,
                       "source_selection": [{**split.partition["train"][int(i)], "train_matrix_row": int(i)} for i in positions]})
    frame, types = technical_fixture()
    result.append({"name": "technical_fixture", "label": 0, "frame": frame, "types": types,
                   "dataset": "technical_fixture", "source_selection": None})
    constant = frame.iloc[[0, 0, 0]].reset_index(drop=True)
    result.insert(0, {"name": "all_constant", "label": 0, "frame": constant, "types": types,
                     "dataset": "all_constant", "source_selection": None})
    return result


def state_record(model):
    """Compare serializable state, including individual Booster bytes/configs."""
    attributes = {name: hashlib.sha256(pickle.dumps(value)).hexdigest() for name, value in vars(model).items()}
    boosters = []
    def visit(value):
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            for item in value:
                visit(item)
        elif hasattr(value, "save_raw"):
            boosters.append({"raw_sha256": hashlib.sha256(value.save_raw(raw_format="ubj")).hexdigest(),
                             "config": json.loads(value.save_config())})
    visit(model.regr)
    return {"pickle_sha256": hashlib.sha256(pickle.dumps(model)).hexdigest(),
            "attribute_sha256": attributes, "boosters": boosters}


def inspect_transformations(generator):
    directory, plan, codec = generator.directory, generator.plan, generator.codec
    with (directory / "model.pkl").open("rb") as stream:
        model = pickle.load(stream)
    X = np.load(directory / "constructor_input.npy", allow_pickle=False)
    require(model.label_y is None and model.X_covs is None, "Model unexpectedly received labels/covariates")
    expected = pd.DataFrame(X, columns=[str(i) for i in range(X.shape[1])])
    for i in codec.record["indices"]["cat_indexes"]:
        expected = pd.get_dummies(expected, columns=[str(i)], prefix=str(i), dtype="float", drop_first=True)
    dummies = expected.to_numpy()
    checks = {
        "constructor_matrix_matches_plan": hashlib.sha256(X.tobytes()).hexdigest() == plan["encoded_input"]["sha256"],
        "no_target_or_covariates": model.label_y is None and model.X_covs is None,
        "rows": model.b == len(X), "dummy_dimension": model.c == dummies.shape[1],
        "cat_indexes": model.cat_indexes == plan["effective_parameters"]["cat_indexes"],
        "int_and_binary_indexes": model.int_indexes == plan["effective_parameters"]["int_indexes"] + plan["effective_parameters"]["bin_indexes"],
        "empirical_min": np.array_equal(model.X_min.reshape(-1), X.min(axis=0)),
        "empirical_max": np.array_equal(model.X_max.reshape(-1), X.max(axis=0)),
        "scaler_min": np.array_equal(model.scaler.data_min_, dummies.min(axis=0)),
        "scaler_max": np.array_equal(model.scaler.data_max_, dummies.max(axis=0)),
        "scaled_train": np.array_equal(model.X1, model.scaler.transform(dummies)),
        "scaler_class_rows": model.scaler.n_samples_seen_ == len(X),
        "dummy_names": (list(model.X_names_after) == list(expected) if model.cat_indexes else True),
    }
    inverse = model.clean_onehot_data(model.unscale(model.X1.copy()))
    # Predetermined float64 arithmetic bound for scaler inversion ONLY; sequences remain exact.
    tolerance = 32*np.finfo(np.float64).eps*np.maximum(1., np.abs(X).max(axis=0))
    checks["native_train_inverse_within_machine_bound"] = bool((np.abs(inverse-X) <= tolerance).all())
    for name in codec.record["categories_ordinal_to_original"]:
        j = codec.record["variable_columns"].index(name)
        checks[f"exact_train_category_inverse_{name}"] = bool(np.array_equal(inverse[:, j], X[:, j]))
    native = {"checks": {k: bool(v) for k, v in checks.items()}, "encoded_shape": list(X.shape),
              "dummy_shape": list(dummies.shape), "dummy_names": list(expected),
              "X_min": model.X_min.tolist(), "X_max": model.X_max.tolist(),
              "scaler": {name: getattr(model.scaler, name).tolist() for name in
                         ("data_min_", "data_max_", "data_range_", "scale_", "min_")},
              "scaler_feature_range": list(model.scaler.feature_range),
              "inverse_absolute_error_per_column": np.abs(inverse-X).max(axis=0).tolist(),
              "inverse_machine_bound_per_column": tolerance.tolist(),
              "native_pre_inverse_generated_output": "not exposed by generate; not reconstructed"}
    np.save(directory / "native_scaled_train.npy", model.X1, allow_pickle=False)
    np.save(directory / "dummified_train.npy", dummies, allow_pickle=False)
    np.save(directory / "native_inverse_train.npy", inverse, allow_pickle=False)
    # Probe the real rounding+clipping method on a COPY, separately from generated samples.
    probe = np.tile(X[0], (4, 1))
    for j in model.int_indexes:
        low, high = X[:, j].min(), X[:, j].max()
        probe[:, j] = [low-.8, low+.2, high-.2, high+.8]
    rounded = probe.copy()
    rounded[:, model.int_indexes] = np.round(rounded[:, model.int_indexes])
    expected_clip = np.clip(rounded, model.X_min, model.X_max)
    actual_clip = model.clip_extremes(probe.copy())
    native["rounding_then_clipping_probe"] = comparison(actual_clip, expected_clip)
    native["probe_is_generated_sample"] = False
    np.save(directory / "round_clip_probe_input.npy", probe, allow_pickle=False)
    np.save(directory / "round_clip_probe_output.npy", actual_clip, allow_pickle=False)
    native["probe_fractional_count_outputs"] = {name: actual_clip[:, j].tolist() for j, name in
                enumerate(codec.record["variable_columns"]) if codec.record["types"][name] == "count"}
    write_json(directory / "native_transformations.json", native)
    require(all(checks.values()) and native["rounding_then_clipping_probe"]["exact_equal"], "Native transformation check failed")
    return native


def reference_sequence(generator):
    directory = generator.directory / "in_memory_reference"
    directory.mkdir()
    initial = read(generator.directory / "sampling_state.json")
    write_json(directory / "initial_sampling_state.json", initial)
    generator._check(generator.plan["training_class"])
    with (generator.directory / "model.pkl").open("rb") as stream:
        model = pickle.load(stream)
    before = state_record(model)
    write_json(directory / "model_state_initial.json", before)
    outer = pack_rng(np.random.get_state())
    batches = []
    with isolated_rng(initial["rng"]):
        for batch in (1, 2):
            audit = directory / f"sample_{batch:04d}"
            audit.mkdir()
            started = time.perf_counter()
            record = {"execution_kind": "real_validation", "path": "in_memory_reference", "requested_rows": 8,
                      "generate_calls": 1, "status": "started", "delivered_rows": 0}
            write_json(audit / "rng_before.json", pack_rng(np.random.get_state()))
            caught = []
            try:
                with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
                    warnings.simplefilter("always")
                    raw = np.asarray(model.generate(batch_size=8)).copy()
                np.save(audit / "library_return.npy", raw, allow_pickle=False)
                record.update(produced_rows=len(raw), shape=list(raw.shape), dtype=str(raw.dtype),
                              nonfinite_values=int((~np.isfinite(raw)).sum()))
                decoded = generator.codec.decode(raw)
                np.save(audit / "decoded_return.npy", decoded.to_numpy(), allow_pickle=False)
                decoded.to_csv(audit / "decoded_return.csv", index=False)
                frame = pd.DataFrame(np.load(generator.directory / "reference_train.npy", allow_pickle=False),
                                     columns=generator.codec.record["columns"])
                ref = training_reference(frame.to_numpy(), list(frame),
                      {"types": generator.codec.record["types"], "categorical_domains": {}},
                      generator.codec.record["categories_ordinal_to_original"])
                write_json(audit / "diagnostic.json", diagnose(decoded, frame.to_numpy(), list(frame), ref,
                           requested=8, stage="real_validation_in_memory_reference", delivered=0))
                validate_synthetic(decoded, list(frame), 8)
                record.update(status="completed_reference", selected_rows=8, padding_rows=0,
                              delivered_rows=0, reference_rows=8, excess_discarded_rows=0, deficit_rows=0)
                batches.append({"raw": raw, "decoded": decoded.to_numpy(), "rng": pack_rng(np.random.get_state())})
            except Exception as exc:
                record.update(status="failed", error={"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
                raise
            finally:
                record.update(seconds=time.perf_counter()-started, warnings=[str(w.message) for w in caught])
                write_json(audit / "rng_after.json", pack_rng(np.random.get_state()))
                write_json(audit / "execution.json", record)
                write_json(audit / "model_state_after.json", state_record(model))
                with (audit / "model_after_generate.pkl").open("xb") as stream:
                    pickle.dump(model, stream)
    after = state_record(model)
    changed = [key for key in before["attribute_sha256"] if before["attribute_sha256"][key] != after["attribute_sha256"][key]]
    result = {"batches": batches, "model_state_changed_attributes": changed,
              "model_pickle_bytes_changed": before["pickle_sha256"] != after["pickle_sha256"],
              "boosters_changed": before["boosters"] != after["boosters"],
              "outer_rng_restored": outer == pack_rng(np.random.get_state())}
    write_json(directory / "sequence_summary.json", {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "batches"})
    require(result["outer_rng_restored"], "Reference path contaminated exterior RNG")
    return result


def rejection_checks(generator):
    before = pack_rng(np.random.get_state())
    results = {}
    def rejects(name, fn):
        try:
            fn()
        except ValueError as exc:
            results[name] = {"rejected": True, "message": str(exc)}
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"Did not reject {name}")
    with patch("src.revision_forest.pickle.load", side_effect=AssertionError("Rejected before deserialize")):
        rejects("requested_other_class", lambda: generator.sample(8, requested_class=1-generator.plan["training_class"]))
        rejects("wrong_path", lambda: RevisedForestGenerator(generator.plan,
                generator.directory.parent / f"class_{1-generator.plan['training_class']}", real_validation=True))
        path = generator.directory / "metadata.json"
        original = path.read_bytes()
        bad = read(path)
        bad["training_class"] = 1-generator.plan["training_class"]
        try:
            path.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
            rejects("wrong_metadata", lambda: generator.sample(8, requested_class=generator.plan["training_class"]))
        finally:
            path.write_bytes(original)
    rejects("wrong_quota", lambda: generator.sample(9, requested_class=generator.plan["training_class"]))
    rejects("real_plan_without_explicit_validation", lambda: RevisedForestGenerator(generator.plan, generator.directory).fit(
            pd.DataFrame(np.load(generator.directory / "reference_train.npy"), columns=generator.codec.record["columns"])))
    require(before == pack_rng(np.random.get_state()), "Rejection changed external RNG")
    results["outer_rng_restored"] = True
    write_json(generator.directory / "rejections.json", results)
    return results


def run_worker(output, run_id):
    output = Path(output)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    results, live, references = [], {}, {}
    try:
        from main_validate_revision_forest import THREAD_ENV
        require(all(os.environ.get(k) == v for k, v in THREAD_ENV.items()), "Thread environment not set before imports")
        run = RevisedRun(run_id)
        split = run.load("cervical_cancer", 13)
        context = run.identity(split, "forestdiffusion")
        for name in ("src/revision_forest_validation.py", "main_validate_revision_forest.py"):
            context["code_sha256"][name] = digest(Path(name))
        write_json(output / "configuration.json", {"execution_kind": "real_validation", "parameters": VALIDATION_PARAMS,
                   "samples_per_request": 8, "context": context, "no_classifiers": True, "full_benchmark": "blocked"})
        for case in cases_for(run, split):
            name, frame, label = case["name"], case["frame"], case["label"]
            result = {"case": name, "class": label, "rows": len(frame), "execution_kind": "real_validation",
                      "fit": "not_run", "sampling": "not_run", "inverse": "not_run", "reload": "not_run"}
            results.append(result)
            case_dir = output / name
            case_dir.mkdir()
            frame.to_csv(case_dir / "prepared_input.csv", index=False)
            np.save(case_dir / "prepared_input.npy", frame.to_numpy(), allow_pickle=False)
            write_json(case_dir / "selection.json", {"frame": frame_record(frame), "source_selection": case["source_selection"],
                       "test_used_for_fit": False, "target_as_predictor": False, "fitted_codec_on_exact_subset": True})
            scoped = {**context, "validation_scope": VALIDATION_SCOPE, "validation_case": name,
                      "dataset": case["dataset"], "subset": frame_record(frame)}
            plan = make_plan(frame, case["types"], scoped, label, VALIDATION_PARAMS, real_validation=True)
            write_json(case_dir / "plan.json", plan)
            model_dir = case_dir / "models" / value_hash(plan) / f"class_{label}"
            generator = RevisedForestGenerator(plan, model_dir, real_validation=True)
            outer = pack_rng(np.random.get_state())
            try:
                if name == "all_constant":
                    # Guard only this negative case; restore the real class before any fit.
                    with isolated_rng(outer), patch("ForestDiffusion.ForestDiffusionModel", side_effect=AssertionError("Forbidden constant-table constructor")) as forbidden:
                        try:
                            generator.fit(frame)
                        except ValueError as exc:
                            require("All-constant" in str(exc), "Unexpected constant-case failure")
                            require(forbidden.call_count == 0 and not model_dir.exists(), "Constant case reached constructor/output")
                            result.update(fit="expected_rejection_before_constructor", status="passed", constructor_calls=0,
                                          reason=str(exc), kept_columns=len(frame.columns), variable_columns=0)
                        else:
                            raise AssertionError("Constant case did not reject")
                else:
                    generator.fit(frame)
                    result.update(fit="passed", constructor_calls=1, kept_columns=len(frame.columns),
                                  variable_columns=len(plan["codec"]["variable_columns"]),
                                  constants=plan["codec"]["constants"], model_directory=str(model_dir))
                    inspect_transformations(generator)
                    result["transforms"] = "passed"
                    references[name] = reference_sequence(generator)
                    rejection_checks(generator)
                    live[name] = generator
                    result["status"] = "awaiting_adapter_sequence"
                require(outer == pack_rng(np.random.get_state()), "Fit/reference contaminated exterior RNG")
                result["outer_rng_restored"] = True
            except Exception as exc:
                result.update(status="failed", error={"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}, traceback=traceback.format_exc())
                fit_path = model_dir / "fit_execution.json"
                if fit_path.exists():
                    result["constructor_calls"] = read(fit_path)["constructor_calls"]
            write_json(case_dir / "fit_and_reference_result.json", result.copy())

        # Interleave classes, reconstructing the adapter and reloading model.pkl on EVERY call.
        sequence = [("cervical_class_0", 1), ("cervical_class_1", 1), ("cervical_class_0", 2),
                    ("cervical_class_1", 2), ("technical_fixture", 1), ("technical_fixture", 2)]
        comparisons = []
        for name, batch in sequence:
            if name not in live:
                continue
            generator = live[name]
            result = next(r for r in results if r["case"] == name)
            try:
                outer = pack_rng(np.random.get_state())
                fresh = RevisedForestGenerator(read(generator.directory / "plan.json"), generator.directory, real_validation=True)
                decoded = fresh.sample(8, requested_class=generator.plan["training_class"])
                audit = generator.directory / f"sample_{batch:04d}"
                raw = np.load(audit / "library_return.npy", allow_pickle=False)
                reference = references[name]["batches"][batch-1]
                item = {"case": name, "batch": batch, "native": comparison(reference["raw"], raw),
                        "decoded": comparison(reference["decoded"], decoded.to_numpy()),
                        "rng_after_exact_equal": read(audit / "rng_after.json") == reference["rng"],
                        "outer_rng_restored": pack_rng(np.random.get_state()) == outer,
                        "rng_advanced": read(audit / "rng_before.json") != read(audit / "rng_after.json"),
                        "adapter_reconstructed": True, "model_reloaded_from_initial_fit": True,
                        "global_interleave_position": len(comparisons)+1}
                comparisons.append(item)
                write_json(audit / "comparison_with_in_memory.json", item)
                require(item["native"]["exact_equal"] and item["native"]["same_dtype"] and
                        item["decoded"]["exact_equal"] and item["decoded"]["same_dtype"] and
                        item["rng_after_exact_equal"] and item["outer_rng_restored"] and item["rng_advanced"],
                        "In-memory and reload sequences differ; evidence retained; no retries/tolerance relaxation")
                for col, value in generator.codec.record["constants"].items():
                    require((decoded[col] == value).all() and str(decoded[col].dtype) == generator.codec.record["dtypes"][col],
                            "Constant restoration mismatch")
                for col, codes in generator.codec.record["categories_ordinal_to_original"].items():
                    require(decoded[col].isin(codes).all(), "Categorical inverse outside original mapping")
                result.update(sampling="passed", inverse="passed", reload="passed", status="passed" if batch == 2 else "awaiting_second_batch",
                              model_state_changed_attributes=references[name]["model_state_changed_attributes"],
                              model_pickle_bytes_changed=references[name]["model_pickle_bytes_changed"],
                              boosters_changed=references[name]["boosters_changed"],
                              adapter_delivered_rows=batch*8)
            except Exception as exc:
                result.update(status="failed", error={"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}, traceback=traceback.format_exc())
                del live[name]  # Do not retry or continue a failed case.
        try:
            generator_inputs(split, "forestdiffusion")
        except ValueError as exc:
            require("ForestDiffusion blocked" in str(exc), "Unexpected benchmark guard")
            benchmark_blocked = True
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Full benchmark was unblocked")
        final = {"execution_kind": "real_validation", "status": "passed" if all(r["status"] == "passed" for r in results) else "failed",
                 "cases": results, "sequence_comparisons": comparisons, "benchmark_blocked": benchmark_blocked,
                 "actual_constructor_calls": sum(r.get("constructor_calls", 0) for r in results),
                 "reference_generate_calls": sum(len(r["batches"]) for r in references.values()),
                 "adapter_generate_calls": len(comparisons), "classifiers_trained": 0,
                 "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter()-start, "self_peak_rss_bytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss*1024,
                 "A1": "open", "A3": "open"}
        pd.DataFrame([{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k not in ("traceback", "constants")} for r in results]).to_csv(output / "case_results.csv", index=False)
        write_json(output / "validation_result.json", final)
        print(json.dumps(final, indent=2))
        return 0 if final["status"] == "passed" else 1
    except Exception as exc:
        write_json(output / "worker_failure.json", {"execution_kind": "real_validation", "cases": results,
                   "error": {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}, "traceback": traceback.format_exc()})
        raise

"""Audit installed source and pure preprocessing; never initialize/train a generator."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import json
import pickle
import tempfile
import warnings
from importlib.metadata import distribution
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from config.const import ROOT_DIR
from src.revision_a1 import digest

AUDITED_MODELS = ("great", "tabula", "realtabformer", "ctgan", "copulagan", "tvae", "gaussian_copula", "tabpfgen", "mostlyai")
SOURCES = {
    "be-great": ["be_great/great.py", "be_great/great_dataset.py"],
    "realtabformer": ["realtabformer/realtabformer.py", "realtabformer/data_utils.py", "realtabformer/rtf_sampler.py"],
    "sdv": ["sdv/single_table/ctgan.py", "sdv/single_table/copulagan.py", "sdv/single_table/copulas.py",
            "sdv/single_table/base.py", "sdv/data_processing/data_processor.py", "sdv/metadata/single_table.py"],
    "ctgan": ["ctgan/data_transformer.py", "ctgan/data_sampler.py", "ctgan/synthesizers/ctgan.py", "ctgan/synthesizers/tvae.py"],
    "rdt": ["rdt/transformers/numerical.py", "rdt/transformers/categorical.py"],
    "copulas": ["copulas/multivariate/gaussian.py"],
    "tabpfgen": ["tabpfgen/tabpfgen.py"],
    "tabpfn": ["tabpfn/classifier.py", "tabpfn/preprocessing/presets.py", "tabpfn/inference_config.py"],
    "mostlyai-engine": ["mostlyai/engine/_tabular/interface.py", "mostlyai/engine/splitting.py",
                        "mostlyai/engine/analysis.py", "mostlyai/engine/_encoding_types/tabular/numeric.py",
                        "mostlyai/engine/_encoding_types/tabular/categorical.py", "mostlyai/engine/_tabular/generation.py"],
}


def inventory():
    records = {}
    for package, files in SOURCES.items():
        dist = distribution(package)
        records[package] = {"version": dist.version, "files": {}}
        for name in files:
            path = Path(dist.locate_file(name))
            tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
            records[package]["files"][name] = {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest(path),
                "functions": [{"name": node.name, "line": node.lineno, "end_line": node.end_lineno,
                               "arguments": ast.unparse(node.args)} for node in ast.walk(tree)
                              if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))]}
    wrappers = {model: {"path": str(ROOT_DIR / "src/generators" / f"{model}.py"),
                        "sha256": digest(ROOT_DIR / "src/generators" / f"{model}.py")}
                for model in AUDITED_MODELS}
    tabula_paths = [ROOT_DIR / "src/models/tabula/tabula" / name for name in ("tabula.py", "tabula_dataset.py", "tabula_utils.py")]
    import subprocess
    commit = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT_DIR / "src/models/tabula"), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
                            check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT_DIR / "src/models/tabula"), "status", "--short"],
                           check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    return {"libraries": records, "wrappers": wrappers,
            "tabula_checkout": {"commit": commit, "working_tree_status": dirty,
                                "files": {str(p): digest(p) for p in tabula_paths}},
            "evidence": "installed/local source and signatures; no generator initialization, fit or sampling"}


def pure_source_probes():
    # Execute just the pure installed numeric formatter, without importing the neural stack.
    import __future__
    path = Path(distribution("realtabformer").locate_file("realtabformer/data_utils.py"))
    function = next(n for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "process_numeric_data")
    namespace = {"pd": pd, "np": np, "warnings": warnings}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), str(path), "exec",
                 flags=__future__.annotations.compiler_flag), namespace)
    numeric, transform = namespace["process_numeric_data"](pd.Series([1.234567, 2.345678]))
    # Execute the exact delimiter branch from guided GReaT parsing, not a reimplementation.
    gpath = Path(distribution("be-great").locate_file("be_great/great.py"))
    branch = next(n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(gpath.read_text())) if isinstance(n, ast.If)
                  and ast.unparse(n.test) == "';' in raw_value")
    parser = compile(ast.Module(body=[branch], type_ignores=[]), str(gpath), "exec")
    parsing = []
    for value in ("17.25", "17.25;"):
        scope = {"raw_value": value}
        exec(parser, scope)
        parsing.append({"raw_value": value, "parsed_value": scope["value"]})
    return {"kind": "real execution of isolated pure source fragments; no model/token generation",
            "realtabformer_numeric_input": [1.234567, 2.345678], "numeric_output": numeric.tolist(),
            "fitted_formatter_metadata": transform, "great_guided_delimiter_probe": parsing}


def tabpfgen_padding_probe():
    """Real wrapper control flow with a simulated library; preserves its padding policy."""

"""Targeted incident probes: reuse prior evidence; no model or tokenizer loading."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast

from importlib.metadata import distribution
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pandas as pd

from src.revision_a1 import digest


def installed(package, name):
    return Path(distribution(package).locate_file(name))


def guided_parser_probe(raw_value):
    """Execute the installed raw extraction, delimiter, cleanup, numeric regex,
    then its real pd.to_numeric coercion. No model/tokenizer is constructed.
    """
    path = installed("be-great", "be_great/great.py")
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
    guided = next(n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_guided_sample")
    extraction = next(n for n in ast.walk(guided) if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and
                      any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == "raw_value" for t in n.targets))
    delimiter = next(n for n in ast.walk(guided) if isinstance(n, ast.If) and ast.unparse(n.test) == "';' in raw_value")
    cleanup = next(n for n in ast.walk(guided) if isinstance(n, ast.While) and ast.unparse(n.test).startswith("value and"))
    numeric = copy.deepcopy(next(n for n in ast.walk(guided) if isinstance(n, ast.If) and
                                ast.unparse(n.test) == "feature in self.num_cols"))
    numeric.orelse = []  # The unrelated categorical branch is not executed by this probe.
    prompt = "feature is"
    scope = {"generated_text": prompt + raw_value, "prompt": prompt, "feature": "feature",
             "self": SimpleNamespace(num_cols=["feature"]), "re": re}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[extraction, delimiter, cleanup, numeric], type_ignores=[]), str(path), "exec"), scope)
    parsed = pd.to_numeric(pd.Series([scope["value"]]), errors="coerce").iloc[0]
    status = "nan_or_nonconvertible" if pd.isna(parsed) else ("finite" if math.isfinite(float(parsed)) else "nonfinite")
    return {"raw_input": raw_value, "raw_after_extraction": scope["raw_value"], "numeric_text": scope["value"],
            "converted_number": float(parsed) if status == "finite" else None,
            "conversion_status": status, "nonfinite_value": str(parsed) if status == "nonfinite" else None,
            "source_sha256": digest(path), "lines": [extraction.lineno, delimiter.lineno, cleanup.lineno, numeric.lineno]}


PARSER_CASES = ("17.25", "17.25;", "-0.75", "-0.75;", "1e3", "1e3;", "1e-3;", "-1.2e+3;",
                " 17.25 ; ", " 17.25 ", "42", "42;", "-42;", ".75;", "+.75;", "17.;", "1e-;",
                "abc12;", "", "-", "NaN;", "inf;", "1e309;", "17.25 kg;", "17.25 next", "17.25; other is 9")


def metadata_discrepancies(prior, specs):
    """Read the forty existing detections, without running inference again."""
    rows = []
    counts = {}
    for path in sorted(Path(prior).glob("*/seed_*/sdv_metadata_real_probe.json")):
        dataset, seed = path.parent.parent.name, int(path.parent.name.removeprefix("seed_"))
        saved = json.loads(path.read_text())
        left, right = (saved[str(k)]["metadata"]["tables"]["table"]["columns"] for k in (0, 1))
        differing = [name for name in left if left[name] != right[name]]
        counts[f"{dataset}/{seed}"] = len(differing)
        for name in differing:
            rows.append({"dataset": dataset, "seed": seed, "column": name,
                         "explicit_semantic_type": specs[dataset]["types"][name],
                         "class_0": left[name], "class_1": right[name], "evidence_sha256": digest(path)})
    return {"existing_class_detections": 2*len(counts), "discrepant_dataset_seeds": sum(v > 0 for v in counts.values()),

def source_signatures():
    """Only additional sources required for these incidents, not another full audit."""
    paths = [installed("mostlyai-engine", "mostlyai/engine/" + name) for name in
             ("splitting.py", "analysis.py", "encoding.py", "training.py", "generation.py", "_tabular/training.py")]
    paths += [installed("transformers", "transformers/generation/configuration_utils.py"),
              installed("transformers", "transformers/training_args.py"),
              installed("tabpfn", "tabpfn/settings.py"), installed("tabpfn", "tabpfn/base.py"),
              installed("tabpfn", "tabpfn/model_loading.py")]
    result = {}
    for path in paths:
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
        result[str(path)] = {"sha256": digest(path), "functions": [{"name": n.name, "line": n.lineno,
                    "arguments": ast.unparse(n.args)} for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)]}
    config = paths[6]
    cls = next(n for n in ast.parse(config.read_text()).body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "GenerationConfig")
    init = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "__init__")
    defaults = {}
    keys = {"do_sample", "num_beams", "temperature", "top_k", "top_p", "min_p", "typical_p",
            "num_return_sequences", "repetition_penalty", "eos_token_id", "pad_token_id"}
    for n in ast.walk(init):
        if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and isinstance(n.value, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func, ast.Attribute):
            if n.value.func.attr == "pop" and len(n.value.args) >= 2 and isinstance(n.value.args[0], ast.Constant):
                key = n.value.args[0].value
                if key in keys:
                    defaults[key] = ast.literal_eval(n.value.args[1])
    return {"sources": result, "transformers_generation_defaults": defaults,
            "generation_defaults_scope": "installed GenerationConfig defaults; model config can override; no model/tokenizer loaded"}

"""Unambiguous parameters for the nine revised generators; no model imports.

Legacy config aliases are migrated explicitly and recorded. The historical
factory/wrappers keep their old parameter semantics unless this marker is present.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import math

PROTOCOL = "revision_generator_parameters_v1"
MARKER = "_revision_parameters"


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def renamed(params, old, new, default=None):
    require(not (old in params and new in params), f"Ambiguous parameters: use only {new}, never both {old} and {new}")
    if old in params:
        params[new] = params.pop(old)
        return {"from": old, "to": new, "value": params[new], "behavior_changed": False}
    if new not in params and default is not None:
        params[new] = default
    require(new in params, f"Missing explicit parameter {new}")
    return None


def parameter_plan(model, configured, experimental_seed):
    require(model != "forestdiffusion", "ForestDiffusion is outside this parameter policy")
    require(type(experimental_seed) is int and experimental_seed >= 0, "Invalid experimental seed")
    require(MARKER not in configured, "Reserved revised parameter marker")
    before, params = copy.deepcopy(configured), copy.deepcopy(configured)
    aliases, units, randomness = [], {}, {"experimental_seed": experimental_seed,
        "global_seed_setup": "CLI set_global_seed before class fits; Python/NumPy/torch/CUDA and configured backend flags",
        "determinism_verified": False}
    if model == "tabula":
        alias = renamed(params, "top_k", "sampling_batch_size", default=100)
        if alias:
            aliases.append(alias)
        require(type(params["sampling_batch_size"]) is int and params["sampling_batch_size"] > 0,
                "sampling_batch_size must be a positive integer")
        units["sampling_batch_size"] = "candidate rows per library iteration; not token top-k"
    elif model == "realtabformer":
        if "random_state" in params:
            require(type(params["random_state"]) is int and params["random_state"] == experimental_seed,
                    "REaLTabFormer random_state contradicts experimental seed")
        params["random_state"] = experimental_seed
        randomness.update(library_random_state=experimental_seed,
                          previous_library_random_state_default=1029,
                          trainer_seed="not overridden; installed TrainingArguments default 42",
                          data_seed="not overridden; installed TrainingArguments default None",
                          initialization="GPT2Config(n_layer=6)/GPT2LMHeadModel(config), unchanged")
    elif model == "mostlyai":
        alias = renamed(params, "max_training_time", "max_training_time_minutes")
        if alias:
            aliases.append(alias)
        value = params["max_training_time_minutes"]
        require(type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value) and value > 0,
                "max_training_time_minutes must be positive; API maps zero to its default")
        units["max_training_time_minutes"] = {"library_argument": "max_training_time", "unit": "minutes",
                                               "library_internal_seconds": value*60}
        randomness.update(library_seed_argument=None,
                          limitation="installed split/analyze/encode/train/generate expose no RNG seed; seed_data is conditioning data")
    params[MARKER] = {"protocol": PROTOCOL, "model": model, "experimental_seed": experimental_seed}
    if model == "great":
        from src.revision_great import correction_record
        params[MARKER]["great_correction"] = correction_record()
    if model == "tabpfgen":
        from src.revision_tabpfgen import policy_record
        params[MARKER]["completion_policy"] = policy_record()
    return {"protocol": PROTOCOL, "model": model, "configured": before, "effective_wrapper_parameters": params,
            "alias_migrations": aliases, "units": units, "randomness": randomness,
            "sampling_budgets": "unchanged; definitive limits require protocol decision"}


def revised_context(params, model):
    """Validate wrapper activation; return None for the untouched historical path."""
    if MARKER not in params:
        return None
    context = params[MARKER]
    require(context.get("protocol") == PROTOCOL and context.get("model") == model,
            "Invalid revised generator parameter context")
    require(type(context.get("experimental_seed")) is int, "Missing experimental seed")
    if model == "tabula":
        require("top_k" not in params and type(params.get("sampling_batch_size")) is int and
                params["sampling_batch_size"] > 0, "Ambiguous/invalid revised TabuLa batch size")
    elif model == "realtabformer":
        require(type(params.get("random_state")) is int and params["random_state"] == context["experimental_seed"],
                "REaLTabFormer random_state contradicts experimental seed")
    elif model == "mostlyai":
        require("max_training_time" not in params and "max_training_time_minutes" in params,
                "Ambiguous revised MOSTLY training-time units")
        value = params["max_training_time_minutes"]
        require(type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value) and value > 0,
                "max_training_time_minutes must be positive; API maps zero to its default")
    return context

"""Explicit test doubles plus installed pure dispatch/parsing methods. No weights."""
import __future__
import ast
from contextlib import nullcontext
import json

import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import re
import shutil
import types

import pandas as pd
import torch

from src.generators.base import BaseGenerator
from src.revision_great import correction_record


class ProgressDouble:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs): pass
    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, *args): pass
    def update(self, *args): pass


def installed_methods():
    path = Path(correction_record()['upstream_path'])
    cls = next(n for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'GReaT')
    nodes = [n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in ('sample', '_guided_sample')]
    scope = {'pd':pd, 'random':random, 're':re, 'logging':logging, 'tqdm':ProgressDouble}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),str(path),'exec',
                 flags=__future__.annotations.compiler_flag),scope)
    return scope


class BatchDouble(dict):
    def to(self, device): return self


class TokenizerDouble:
    eos_token_id = 9999
    def __init__(self, *, multi=False, normalize=False, padding=0, fail_delimiter=False):
        self.multi, self.normalize, self.padding, self.fail_delimiter = multi, normalize, padding, fail_delimiter
    def encode(self, text, add_special_tokens=False):
        if self.fail_delimiter and text == ';':
            raise ValueError('simulated delimiter encoding failure')
        result=[]
        for character in text:
            result.extend([2000,2001] if character == ';' and self.multi else [ord(character)+10])
        return result
    def decode(self, values, skip_special_tokens=False):
        if hasattr(values,'tolist'): values=values.tolist()
        result, i = '', 0
        while i < len(values):
            token=int(values[i])
            if token == 2000 and i+1 < len(values) and int(values[i+1]) == 2001:
                result+=';'; i+=2; continue
            if token in (2000,2001): result+='<delimiter-part>'
            elif token == self.eos_token_id:
                if not skip_special_tokens: result+='<|endoftext|>'
            elif token >= 10: result+=chr(token-10)
            i+=1
        return re.sub(' +',' ',result) if self.normalize else result
    def __call__(self,text,return_tensors='pt'):
        encoded=self.encode(text)
        return BatchDouble(input_ids=torch.tensor([[self.eos_token_id]*self.padding+encoded]),
                           attention_mask=torch.tensor([[0]*self.padding+[1]*len(encoded)]))


class LanguageModelDouble:
    def __init__(self, tokenizer, responses, *, output_kind='tensor', bad_prefix=False):
        self.tokenizer, self.responses = tokenizer, responses
        self.output_kind, self.bad_prefix = output_kind, bad_prefix
        self.calls=[]
        self.config=types.SimpleNamespace(is_encoder_decoder=False)
        self.generation_config=types.SimpleNamespace(eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,max_new_tokens=None)
    def eval(self): pass
    def generate(self,input_ids,**kwargs):
        self.calls.append({'input_ids':input_ids.tolist(),'kwargs':kwargs})
        if not self.responses: raise AssertionError('Unexpected extra generate/retry')
        response=self.responses.pop(0)
        if isinstance(response,Exception): raise response
        if isinstance(response,dict):
            tokens=response.get('ids')
            if tokens is None: tokens=self.tokenizer.encode(response['text'])
            if response.get('eos'): tokens=tokens+[self.tokenizer.eos_token_id]
        else:
            tokens=self.tokenizer.encode(response)
        prefix=input_ids.tolist()[0]
        if self.bad_prefix: prefix=[-1]+prefix[1:]
        sequence=torch.tensor([prefix+tokens])
        if self.output_kind=='object': return types.SimpleNamespace(sequences=sequence)
        if self.output_kind=='dict': return {'sequences':sequence}
        return sequence


def controller(responses, *, columns=None, num_cols=None, tokenizer=None, **kwargs):
    methods=installed_methods()
    class ControllerDouble:
        sample=methods['sample']
        _guided_sample=methods['_guided_sample']
        def _resolve_device(self,device): self.device='cpu'
    instance=ControllerDouble()
    instance.columns=columns or ['number']
    instance.num_cols=num_cols if num_cols is not None else instance.columns.copy()
    instance.conditional_col=instance.columns[0]
    instance.conditional_col_dist={}
    instance.tokenizer=tokenizer or TokenizerDouble()
    instance.model=LanguageModelDouble(instance.tokenizer,list(responses),**kwargs)
    return instance


def wrapper(restore, *, constructor=None):
    path=Path(__file__).parent/'generators/great.py'
    cls=next(n for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef))
    scope={'BaseGenerator':BaseGenerator,'pd':pd,'Path':Path,'os':os,'shutil':shutil,
           'training_workspace':lambda p:nullcontext(),'GReaT':constructor,'_restore_great_from_dir':restore}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[cls],type_ignores=[]),str(path),'exec'),scope)
    return scope[cls.name]

def sha(path):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024*1024), b''):
            result.update(block)
    return result.hexdigest()


def write(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.tmp')
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    temporary.replace(path)


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def json_ready(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: json_ready(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [json_ready(v) for v in value]
    if hasattr(value, 'detach'):
        return value.detach().cpu().tolist()
    return value

def install_network_guard(log):
    """Deny Internet socket creation/connections and DNS; local IPC remains available.

    The audit hook is inherited by the Linux fork data-loader workers. HF is
    additionally offline; no dependency/model fallback is provided.
    """
    def guard(event, args):
        blocked = (event == 'socket.getaddrinfo' or
                  (event == 'socket.__new__' and args[1] in (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6)) or
                  (event in ('socket.connect', 'socket.connect_ex', 'socket.sendto')
                  and args[0].family in (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6))
                  )
        if blocked:
            with Path(log).open('a') as stream:
                stream.write(json.dumps({'event': event, 'pid': os.getpid(), 'blocked': True})+'\n')
            raise OSError('Network disabled for the fixed GReaT validation')
    sys.addaudithook(guard)

def check_contract(output, plan):
    from src.revision_a1_runtime import RevisedRun, value_hash
    require(sha(output/'plan.json') == (output/'plan.sha256').read_text().strip(), 'Immutable plan changed')
    require(sha(plan['config_path']) == plan['config_sha256'], 'Pilot configuration changed')
    for name, expected in plan['validation_code_sha256'].items():
        require(sha(ROOT/name) == expected, 'Validation implementation changed: '+name)
    require(plan['scope'] == SCOPE and plan['device'] == 'cpu', 'Wrong validation scope/device')
    require(plan['fits'] == [{'label': c, 'epochs': 1, 'initial_global_seed': 13} for c in (0, 1)], 'Wrong fit schedule')
    require(plan['requests'] == [{'id': f'class_{c}_request_{j}', 'label': c, 'rows': 2}
                               for c in (0, 1) for j in (1, 2)], 'Wrong request schedule')
    run = RevisedRun(plan['run_id'], config_path=Path(plan['config_path']))
    split = run.load(DATASET, 13)
    current = run.identity(split, 'great')
    require(current == plan['runtime_identity'] and value_hash(current) == plan['runtime_identity_sha256'],
            'Full common runtime identity mismatch, including all hyperparameters')
    for case in plan['classes']:
        require(sha(case['input_path']) == case['input_sha256'], 'Selected train input changed')
    return run, split


def set_phase(output, name):

class RealObserver:
    """Read-only Python profiling of real functions, without replacing any method."""
    def __init__(self, directory):
        import inspect
        from be_great import GReaT
        from transformers.generation.utils import GenerationMixin
        from src.generators.great import _restore_great_from_dir
        self.codes = {inspect.unwrap(GenerationMixin.generate).__code__: 'generate',
            GenerationMixin._get_stopping_criteria.__code__: 'stopping',
            GReaT.fit.__code__: 'fit', _restore_great_from_dir.__code__: 'restore'}
        self.directory, self.calls, self.frames, self.errors = Path(directory), [], {}, []
        self.fit, self.restore, self.tokenizer = None, [], None

    def profile(self, frame, event, value):
        kind = self.codes.get(frame.f_code)
        if kind is None:
            return
        try:
            if kind == 'generate' and event == 'call':
                model = frame.f_locals['self']
                kwargs = frame.f_locals['kwargs']
                item = {'index': len(self.calls)+1, 'device': str(model.device),
                    'arguments': json_ready({k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if k != 'stopping_criteria'}),
                    'extra_stopping_types': [type(s).__name__ for s in kwargs.get('stopping_criteria', [])],
                    'started_monotonic': time.monotonic(), 'status': 'entered'}
                self.calls.append(item)
                self.frames[id(frame)] = item
                write(self.directory/f'generate_{item["index"]:03d}.json', item)
            elif kind == 'stopping' and event == 'return' and value is not None:
                item = self.calls[-1]
                item['effective_generation_config'] = json_ready(frame.f_locals['generation_config'].to_dict())
                item['effective_stopping_types'] = [type(s).__name__ for s in value]
                write(self.directory/f'generate_{item["index"]:03d}.json', item)
            elif kind == 'generate' and event == 'return':
                item = self.frames.pop(id(frame))
                tensor = getattr(value, 'sequences', value)
                item.update(status='returned' if value is not None else 'exception_or_no_return',
                            ended_monotonic=time.monotonic(),
                            output_ids=tensor.detach().cpu().tolist() if hasattr(tensor, 'detach') else None)
                write(self.directory/f'generate_{item["index"]:03d}.json', item)
            elif kind == 'fit' and event == 'return' and value is not None:
                self.fit = {'training_arguments': value.args.to_dict(), 'global_step': value.state.global_step,
                            'epoch': value.state.epoch, 'log_history': value.state.log_history,
                            'train_rows': len(value.train_dataset), 'device': str(value.args.device)}
                write(self.directory/'real_fit.json', self.fit)
            elif kind == 'restore' and event == 'return' and value is not None:
                self.tokenizer = value.tokenizer  # Tokenizer only; never retain model/weights.
                self.restore.append({'class': type(value).__name__, 'model_class': type(value.model).__name__,
                    'device': str(value.model.device), 'columns': value.columns,
                    'num_cols': value.num_cols, 'llm': value.llm,
                    'generation_config_before_dispatch': json_ready(value.model.generation_config.to_dict())})
                write(self.directory/'real_restore.json', self.restore)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.errors.append({'event': event, 'kind': kind, 'error': repr(exc)})
            write(self.directory/'observer_errors.json', self.errors)

    @contextmanager
    def active(self):
        previous = sys.getprofile()
        sys.setprofile(self.profile)
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            sys.setprofile(previous)


def rng_record():
    import pickle
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    return {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in {
        'python': pickle.dumps(random.getstate()), 'numpy': pickle.dumps(np.random.get_state()),
        'torch_cpu': bytes(torch.get_rng_state().tolist())}.items()}


def verify_interpretations(audit_dir, observer):
    """Compare real outputs to audit IDs, independently check finite numeric lexemes."""
    import math
    from decimal import Decimal
    checks = []
    calls = iter(observer.calls)
    for file in sorted(audit_dir.glob('field_*.json')):
        field = read(file)
        returned = None
        for attempt in field['attempts']:
            if attempt['generation_invoked']:
                call = next(calls)
                if call['output_ids'] is not None:
                    returned = call['output_ids'][0]
        require(returned == field.get('sequence_ids'), 'Real generate IDs differ from parser evidence')
        require(returned[field['input_width']:] == field['new_token_ids'], 'Continuation slicing mismatch')
        tokens = field['new_token_ids']
        config = call['effective_generation_config']
        active = config['eos_token_id']
        active = active if isinstance(active, list) else ([] if active is None else [active])
        eos = next((j for j, token in enumerate(tokens) if token in active), None)
        visible = tokens if eos is None else tokens[:eos]
        decoded = observer.tokenizer.decode(visible, skip_special_tokens=False)
        if ';' in decoded:
            closure, raw = 'delimiter', decoded.split(';', 1)[0]
        elif eos is not None:
            closure, raw = 'eos', decoded
        else:
            limit = config.get('max_new_tokens')
            at_limit = len(tokens) >= limit if limit is not None else len(returned) >= config['max_length']
            closure, raw = ('length' if at_limit else 'unknown'), decoded
        require(raw == field['raw_field'] and closure == field['termination'], 'Independent decoding/closure mismatch')
        item = {'field_file': str(file), 'real_output_ids_match': True, 'continuation_ids_match': True,
                'independent_decoding_and_closure_match': True,
                'status': field['status'], 'raw_field': raw, 'termination': closure}
        if field['status'] == 'accepted':
            raw = field['raw_field'].strip()
            require(math.isfinite(float(Decimal(raw))) and float(Decimal(raw)) == field['value'],
                    'Accepted value differs from complete observed literal')
            item.update(value=field['value'], complete_literal_value_matches=True)
        else:
            item['rejection_reason'] = field['reason']
            reason = field['reason']
            literal = re.fullmatch(r'[+-]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?', raw.strip())
            justified = ((reason == 'unclosed_numeric_field' and closure not in ('delimiter', 'eos')) or
                         (reason == 'numeric_grammar' and literal is None) or
                         (reason == 'nonfinite_literal' and not Decimal(raw.strip()).is_finite()) or
                         (reason == 'numeric_overflow' and literal is not None and not math.isfinite(float(raw))) or
                         (reason == 'numeric_underflow' and literal is not None and float(raw) == 0 and Decimal(raw) != 0))
            require(justified, 'Observed rejection does not follow the frozen numeric contract')
            item['rejection_independently_justified'] = True
        checks.append(item)
    require(next(calls, None) is None, 'Unmatched real generate call')
    return checks


def worker(output):
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    install_network_guard(output/'network_worker_blocked.jsonl')
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import torch
    from src.generators.great import GreatGenerator
    from src.revision_a1_runtime import frame_record
    from src.revision_generator_parameters import MARKER
    from src.revision_great import GreatCorrectionError, check_model_identity
    from src.revision_validity import diagnose, training_reference
    from src.utils.seed_utils import set_global_seed
    plan = read(output/'plan.json')
    run, split = check_contract(output, plan)
    require(all(os.environ.get(k) == v for k, v in plan['environment'].items()), 'Worker environment mismatch')
    require(not torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.get_num_threads() == 4, 'Device/thread plan mismatch')
    for name, expected in plan['local_components']['files_sha256'].items():
        require(sha(SNAPSHOT/name) == expected, 'Local component changed')
    params = plan['runtime_identity']['generator_parameters']['effective_wrapper_parameters']
    result = {'scope': SCOPE, 'status': 'started', 'fits': [], 'requests': [], 'benchmark': 'blocked', 'A1_A5': 'open'}
    write(output/'worker_summary.json', result)
    for case, (_, selected, _) in zip(plan['classes'], selected_classes(split)):
        label, model_dir = case['label'], Path(case['model_dir'])
        check_contract(output, plan)
        frame = pd.DataFrame(np.load(case['input_path'], allow_pickle=False), columns=case['columns'])
        require(frame_record(frame) == case['frame'] and frame.equals(selected), 'Class selection mismatch')
        directory = output/f'fit_class_{label}'
        directory.mkdir()
        observer = RealObserver(directory)
        set_phase(output, f'fit_class_{label}')
        started = time.monotonic()
        set_global_seed(13)
        before = rng_record()
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught, observer.active():
            warnings.simplefilter('always')
            GreatGenerator(params).fit(frame, model_dir)
        require(not observer.errors and observer.fit is not None, 'Real fit instrumentation failed')
        require(observer.fit['global_step'] == 2 and observer.fit['epoch'] == 1.0 and
                observer.fit['train_rows'] == 32 and observer.fit['device'] == 'cpu', 'Real fit differs from plan')
        check_model_identity(model_dir, params[MARKER])
        binding = {'runtime_identity': plan['runtime_identity'], 'runtime_identity_sha256': plan['runtime_identity_sha256'],
                   'label': label, 'selected_frame': case['frame']}
        write(model_dir/'validation_runtime_identity.json', binding)
        hashes = {p.name: sha(p) for p in model_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
        record = {'label': label, 'status': 'fit_saved', 'seconds': time.monotonic()-started,
                  'model_files_sha256': hashes, 'runtime_binding': binding, 'rng_before': before,
                  'rng_after': rng_record(), 'warnings': [str(w.message) for w in caught]}
        write(directory/'execution.json', record)
        result['fits'].append(record)
        write(output/'worker_summary.json', result)
        set_phase(output, 'between_fits')
        gc.collect()
    reference = training_reference(split.X_train, split.names, run.policy['datasets'][DATASET], split.preprocessing.train_categories)
    write(output/'train_validity_reference.json', reference)
    set_global_seed(13)
    write(output/'generation_rng_initial.json', rng_record())
    for request in plan['requests']:
        check_contract(output, plan)
        case = plan['classes'][request['label']]
        model_dir = Path(case['model_dir'])
        fit = result['fits'][request['label']]
        require(all(sha(model_dir/name) == expected for name, expected in fit['model_files_sha256'].items()), 'Saved model changed')
        require(read(model_dir/'validation_runtime_identity.json') == fit['runtime_binding'], 'Full runtime binding changed')
        directory = output/request['id']
        directory.mkdir()
        observer = RealObserver(directory)
        generator = GreatGenerator(params)
        record = {**request, 'status': 'started', 'device': 'cpu', 'gpu_memory_bytes': None, 'rng_before': rng_record()}
        write(directory/'execution.json', record)
        set_phase(output, request['id'])
        started = time.monotonic()
        fatal = None
        frame = None
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
            warnings.simplefilter('always')
            try:
                with observer.active():
                    frame = generator.sample(2, model_dir)
                frame.to_csv(directory/'delivered.csv', index=False)
                record['status'] = 'delivered'
            except Exception as exc:
                expected = isinstance(exc, GreatCorrectionError) and exc.reason in PARSING_REJECTIONS
                record.update(status='parsing_rejected' if expected else 'structural_failure',
                              error={'type': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc), 'traceback': traceback.format_exc()})
                if not expected:
                    fatal = exc
        record.update(seconds=time.monotonic()-started, rng_after=rng_record(),
                      warnings=[str(w.message) for w in caught], real_generate_calls=len(observer.calls),
                      observation=getattr(generator, 'sampling_observations', None))
        write(directory/'execution.json', record)  # Preserve failures BEFORE any verification.
        if fatal:
            result['requests'].append(record)
            write(output/'worker_summary.json', result)
            raise fatal
        observation = record['observation']
        require(not observer.errors and len(observer.restore) == 1, 'Real restoration/observer failed')
        if observation:
            audit = Path(observation['audit_directory'])
            checks = verify_interpretations(audit, observer)
            write(directory/'continuation_correspondence.json', checks)
            require(observation['generate_calls'] == len(observer.calls), 'Generate count mismatch')
            complete = frame
            if complete is None and (audit/'completed_rows_withheld.csv').is_file():
                complete = pd.read_csv(audit/'completed_rows_withheld.csv')
            if complete is None:
                complete = pd.DataFrame(columns=split.names, dtype=float)
            write(directory/'validity_complete_rows.json', diagnose(complete, split.X_train, split.names, reference,
                requested=2, stage='real_minimal_complete_rows_only', delivered=observation['delivered_rows'],
                internal_observation=observation))
        result['requests'].append(record)
        write(output/'worker_summary.json', result)
        set_phase(output, 'between_requests')
        del generator, observer
        gc.collect()
    result['status'] = 'scheduled_trial_completed'
    write(output/'worker_summary.json', result)
    set_phase(output, 'completed')
    return 0

        (output/name).chmod(0o444)
    return plan


def dataloader_preflight(output):
    import torch
    from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
    base.set_phase(output, 'dataloader_preflight')
    started = time.monotonic()
    values = torch.arange(32*8, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(32, 8)
    indices = torch.arange(32)
    loader = DataLoader(TensorDataset(values, indices), batch_size=16, num_workers=0, shuffle=False)
    iterator = iter(loader)
    batches = list(iterator)
    actual, ids = torch.cat([b[0] for b in batches]), torch.cat([b[1] for b in batches])
    record = {'pid': os.getpid(), 'status': 'passed', 'num_workers': loader.num_workers,
        'iterator_class': type(iterator).__name__, 'batch_sizes': [len(b[0]) for b in batches],
        'indices': ids.tolist(), 'device': str(actual.device), 'seconds': time.monotonic()-started,
        'exact_values': torch.equal(actual, values), 'exact_indices': torch.equal(ids, indices)}
    write(output/'dataloader_preflight.json', record)
    require(record['exact_values'] and record['exact_indices'] and record['num_workers'] == 0 and
            record['batch_sizes'] == [16, 16] and record['iterator_class'] == '_SingleProcessDataLoaderIter',
            'Local-tensor DataLoader preflight failed; no model training permitted')
    return record


class TrainerGuard:
    """Read-only tracing; works alongside the original observer's profiler."""
    def __init__(self, output):
        from transformers import Trainer
        from be_great.great_trainer import GReaTTrainer
        self.output = output
        self.train_code = inspect.unwrap(Trainer.train).__code__
        self.loader_code = GReaTTrainer.get_train_dataloader.__code__
        self.train_checks = self.loader_checks = 0

    def trace(self, frame, event, value):
        if frame.f_code == self.train_code and event == 'call':
            trainer = frame.f_locals['self']
            phase = read(self.output/'phase.json')['phase']
            record = {'trainer_class': type(trainer).__name__, 'training_arguments': trainer.args.to_dict(),
                'rows': len(trainer.train_dataset), 'device': str(trainer.args.device),
                'dataloader_num_workers': trainer.args.dataloader_num_workers, 'checked_before_train_body': True}
            write(self.output/phase/'trainer_before_train.json', record)
            require(record['dataloader_num_workers'] == 0 and record['rows'] == 32 and
                    record['device'] == 'cpu' and trainer.args.num_train_epochs == 1 and
                    trainer.args.per_device_train_batch_size == 16, 'Real Trainer differs from zero-worker plan')
            self.train_checks += 1
        if frame.f_code == self.loader_code:
            if event == 'call':
                return self.trace
            if event == 'return' and value is not None:
                phase = read(self.output/'phase.json')['phase']
                record = {'class': type(value).__name__, 'num_workers': value.num_workers,
                          'batch_size': value.batch_size, 'dataset_rows': len(value.dataset),
                          'checked_before_iteration': True}
                write(self.output/phase/'real_dataloader.json', record)
                require(record['num_workers'] == 0 and record['dataset_rows'] == 32 and
                        record['batch_size'] == 16, 'Real GReaT DataLoader differs from plan')
                self.loader_checks += 1
                return None
        return None


def worker(output):
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    base.install_network_guard(output/'network_worker_blocked.jsonl')
    plan = read(output/'plan.json')
    base.check_contract(output, plan)
    require(plan['variant'] == VARIANT and
            plan['runtime_identity']['generator_parameters']['effective_wrapper_parameters']['dataloader_num_workers'] == 0,
            'Wrong second-trial variant')
    dataloader_preflight(output)
    guard = TrainerGuard(output)
    previous = sys.gettrace()
    sys.settrace(guard.trace)
    try:
        # Real unchanged worker, wrappers, constructors, fits and generation.
        status = base.worker(output)
    finally:
        sys.settrace(previous)
        write(output/'trainer_checks.json', {'train_checks': guard.train_checks,
              'dataloader_checks': guard.loader_checks})
    require(guard.train_checks == 2 and guard.loader_checks == 2, 'Missing real Trainer/DataLoader checks')
    return status

"""One explicit continuation of retained MOSTLY output; never rerun class zero."""
import copy
import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from src.revision_great_validation import ROOT, read, write, sha, require
from src.revision_a1_runtime import (PINNED_RUN, RevisedRun, frame_record, generator_inputs,
    real_numeric_matrix, validate_synthetic, value_hash)
from src.revision_validity import table_record, training_reference, diagnose


def source_frame(plan):
    source=plan['recovery']['source']
    require(all(sha(Path(p))==digest for p,digest in source['sha256'].items()), 'Recovery source hash mismatch')
    frame=pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(p) for p in source['parquet']],ignore_index=True)
    require(table_record(frame)==source['table_record'], 'Recovery source values/dtypes changed')
    return frame


def prepare(output, previous):
    prior=read(previous/'plan.json')
    require(sha(previous/'plan.json')==(previous/'plan.sha256').read_text().strip(), 'Previous frozen plan changed')
    old_identity=prior['identities']['mostlyai']
    old_models=Path(prior['paths']['mostlyai']['model']); old_results=Path(prior['paths']['mostlyai']['results'])
    old_state=read(previous/'mostlyai/generation/state.json')
    require(old_state['status']=='failed' and old_state['error']['type']=='TypeError' and
            len(old_state['classes'])==1 and old_state['classes'][0]['samples'][0]['wrapper_return_rows']==20,
            'Unexpected recovery source state')
    require(not (old_models/'class_1').exists(), 'Class one already exists; continuation would repeat it')
    configuration=read(previous/'pilot_config.json')
    configuration['technical_pilot']['mostly_recovery']={'version':1,'source_identity_sha256':value_hash(old_identity),
        'previous_plan_sha256':sha(previous/'plan.json'),'directory':str(output)}
    (output/'pilot_config.json').write_text(json.dumps(configuration,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    comparison=copy.deepcopy(configuration);del comparison['technical_pilot']['mostly_recovery']
    require(comparison==read(previous/'pilot_config.json'),'Unauthorized pilot configuration change')
    run=RevisedRun(PINNED_RUN,config_path=output/'pilot_config.json');split=run.load(prior['dataset'],13)
    identity,model_dir,results=run.paths(split,'mostlyai')
    require(not model_dir.exists() and not results.exists(),'Recovery identity already exists')
    require(identity['runtime']==old_identity['runtime'] and identity['artifact_hashes']==old_identity['artifact_hashes'] and
            identity['generator_parameters']==old_identity['generator_parameters'],'Incompatible source runtime/data/generator parameters')
    code_changes={p:{'old':h,'current':sha(ROOT/p)} for p,h in old_identity['code_sha256'].items() if sha(ROOT/p)!=h}
    require(set(code_changes)=={'src/revision_a1_runtime.py','src/revision_utility.py'},'Unexpected source identity change')
    inputs=dict(generator_inputs(split,'mostlyai'))
    require(frame_record(inputs[0])==old_state['classes'][0]['input'],'Class-zero training provenance mismatch')
    parquet=sorted((old_models/'class_0/SyntheticData').glob('*.parquet'))
    require(bool(parquet),'Retained native output unavailable')
    native=pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(p) for p in parquet],ignore_index=True)
    validated=validate_synthetic(native,split.names,20)
    old_csv=old_results/'raw_return_class_0.csv'
    require(native.to_csv(index=False).encode()==old_csv.read_bytes(),'Native output differs from retained wrapper return')
    require(np.array_equal(real_numeric_matrix(validated),pd.read_csv(old_csv,float_precision='round_trip').to_numpy()),
            'Retained CSV differs from native output')
    require(table_record(native)==read(old_results/'validity_class_0.json')['wrapper_return_hash'], 'Prior return table hash mismatch')
    source_paths=parquet+[old_csv,old_results/'identity.json',old_results/'validity_class_0.json',previous/'mostlyai/generation/state.json']
    plan=copy.deepcopy(prior)
    plan.update(models=['mostlyai'],identities={'mostlyai':identity},paths={'mostlyai':{'model':str(model_dir),'results':str(results)}},
                config_sha256=sha(output/'pilot_config.json'),preflight_blocked={},forest_plans=[],
                previous_pilot={'path':str(previous),'plan_sha256':sha(previous/'plan.json'),'manifest_sha256':sha(previous/'delivery_manifest.json')})
    plan['recovery']={'kind':'retained class0 plus class1 continuation; not a fresh successful complete run',
        'fit_classes':[1],'generate_classes':[1],'recover_classes':[0],'reused_models':False,
        'old_identity':old_identity,'old_identity_sha256':value_hash(old_identity),'authorized_code_changes':code_changes,
        'source':{'parquet':[str(p) for p in parquet],'raw_csv':str(old_csv),
                  'sha256':{str(p):sha(p) for p in source_paths},'table_record':table_record(native)},
        'data_compatibility':'same full class0 train hash, fixed split/preprocessing, parameters, versions; only samples reused, no old model loaded'}
    plan['cache_environment']={'HF_DATASETS_CACHE':str(output/'mostlyai/generation/cache/datasets'),'HOME':'inherited unchanged'}
    plan['evaluation']='Existing evaluation for recovered class0 + newly generated class1, 20/20; reuse original baselines'
    plan['versions']={n:importlib.metadata.version(n) for n in prior['versions']}
    require(plan['versions']==prior['versions'],'Dependency versions changed')
    protected=read(output/'before.json')['files_sha256']
    for p in ['src/revision_a1_runtime.py','src/revision_utility.py','main_revision_common_pilot.py',
              'src/revision_mostly_recovery.py','tests/test_revision_nullable_numeric.py']:
        protected[p]=sha(ROOT/p)
    write(output/'protected_before.json',protected);plan['protected_inventory_sha256']=sha(output/'protected_before.json')
    write(output/'plan.json',plan);(output/'plan.sha256').write_text(sha(output/'plan.json')+'\n')
    write(output/'recovery_preflight.json',{'validated_native_class0_rows':len(native),'values_and_dtypes_unchanged':True,
        'source_hashes':plan['recovery']['source']['sha256'],'model_reused':False,'source_identity_changes':code_changes})
    for name in ['plan.json','plan.sha256','pilot_config.json','protected_before.json']:(output/name).chmod(0o444)
    return plan


def generation(run, split, model, directory, plan, state, state_path):
    require(model=='mostlyai' and plan['recovery']['fit_classes']==[1] and plan['quota_per_class']==20,
            'Outside explicit MOSTLY continuation')
    from src.generators import get_generator
    from src.utils.seed_utils import set_global_seed
    from main_revision_common_pilot import load_contract
    set_global_seed(13)
    identity,model_dir,output=run.paths(split,model)
    require(identity==plan['identities'][model],'Recovery identity mismatch')
    model_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    write(output/'identity.json',identity);write(output/'generator_parameters.json',identity['generator_parameters'])
    write(output/'recovery_provenance.json',plan['recovery'])
    reference=training_reference(split.X_train,split.names,run.policy['datasets'][split.dataset],split.preprocessing.train_categories)
    write(output/'validity_reference.json',reference)
    files={};inputs=dict(generator_inputs(split,model))
    for label in (0,1):
        entry={'label':label,'status':'recovering' if label==0 else 'fit_started','train_rows':len(inputs[label]),'samples':[]}
        state['classes'].append(entry);write(state_path,state)
        if label==0:
            frame=source_frame(plan)
            shutil.copyfile(plan['recovery']['source']['raw_csv'],output/'raw_return_class_0.csv')
            require(sha(output/'raw_return_class_0.csv')==sha(Path(plan['recovery']['source']['raw_csv'])),'Raw recovery copy mismatch')
            entry.update(fit_performed=False,generate_calls=0,recovered_rows=len(frame))
        else:
            generator=get_generator(model,identity['generator_parameters']['effective_wrapper_parameters'])
            generator.fit(inputs[label].copy(),model_dir/'class_1')
            entry['status']='fit_completed';write(state_path,state)
            with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
                warnings.simplefilter('always')
                frame=generator.sample(20,model_dir/'class_1')
            entry.update(fit_performed=True,generate_calls=1,produced_rows=len(frame),warnings=[str(w.message) for w in caught])
            frame.to_csv(output/'raw_return_class_1.csv',index=False,mode='x')
        frame.to_pickle(output/f'native_return_class_{label}.pkl')
        diagnostic=diagnose(frame,split.X_train,split.names,reference,requested=20,
            stage='recovered_retained_return' if label==0 else 'new_class1_wrapper_return',delivered=None)
        write(output/f'validity_class_{label}.json',diagnostic)
        validated=validate_synthetic(frame,split.names,20)
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(validated,frame)
        diagnostic.update(status='delivered',delivered_rows=20,validation_representation='temporary numeric array only; source dtypes/values preserved')
        write(output/f'validity_class_{label}.json',diagnostic)
        validated['class']=np.full(20,label,dtype=np.int32)
        path=output/f'synthetic_class_{label}.csv';validated.to_csv(path,index=False,mode='x');files[path.name]=sha(path)
        reloaded=pd.read_csv(path,float_precision='round_trip')
        require(np.array_equal(real_numeric_matrix(frame),real_numeric_matrix(reloaded[split.names])), 'CSV boundary changed values')
        entry.update(status='recovered_delivered' if label==0 else 'generated_delivered',delivered_rows=20,
                     source_table=table_record(frame),csv_representation_value_preservation=True)
        write(state_path,state)
    write(output/'samples_manifest.json',{'identity':identity,'inputs':[{'label':k,'fit':frame_record(v),
        'fit_performed_in_continuation':k==1} for k,v in inputs.items()],
        'files':files,'postprocessing':'no correction; class0 recovered, class1 newly generated; labels from class-specific provenance',
        'observability_files':{p.name:sha(p) for p in output.iterdir() if p.name.startswith(('validity_','raw_return_','native_return_','recovery_'))}})
    final=load_contract(run,split,model)
    require(len(final)==40,'Continuation contract failure')
    state.update(status='completed',operation=plan['recovery']['kind'],contract_valid=True,
                 delivered_per_class={str(k):int(v) for k,v in final['class'].value_counts().items()},
                 class0_refit=False,class0_regenerated=False,old_model_loaded=False)
